O ninho {onde} já está no rolo de filme.en: The nest {onde} is already on the birdwatcher's film roll. The chicks didn't even look at the camera.

Um ninho de gravetos {onde}. Dentro, ovo.en: A nest of twigs {onde}. Inside, warm eggs and a smell of grass.

CLIQUE! {JOGADOR} fotografou o ninho com.en: CLICK! {JOGADOR} photographed the nest with the borrowed camera, without touching a thing.

Melhor não mexer. Ninho tocado é ninho a.en: Better not touch. A touched nest is an abandoned nest.

Chegamos, Campeão! Vila Cascavel, porta.en: We're here, Champion! Vila Cascavel, gateway to the Sertão das Névoas. Step down slowly: the platform is old and the mountain is young.

Aqui o mato é outro e os bichos já nasce.en: The brush is different here and the critters are born League-sized. No level-five Tamanduí: here it's Emaçu from forty-five up. The first gym in the Sertão is Cowgirl Zefa's, in Pantanal Grande, to the east. You can walk there, through the Vereda, the Cerrado and the Pantanal boardwalks… or go by canoe, across the village lagoon.

E não estranhe: a Vila Cascavel não tem.en: And don't be surprised: Vila Cascavel has no gym. The stone building became the Herbalist's Hall. Dona Sucupira heals your team there for free.

Rádio Cipó, edição do Sertão! Notícia ur.en: Rádio Cipó, Sertão edition! Breaking news: the Environmental Police ask everyone to watch out for people in rust-colored overalls in the Pantanal. If you see a cage, tell Cowgirl Zefa.

Chegue, menino. Sente. Deixe as cuias aq.en: Come in, child. Sit. Leave the gourds here on the bench and I'll rub some bark tea on each one.

Pronto: jurubeba para o fígado, barbatim.en: There: jurubeba for the liver, barbatimão for the cuts and a head pat for the soul. Your team is good as new.

E aquele pergaminho, você já ensinou? Fo.en: And that scroll, have you taught it yet? Root strength isn't for keeping: it's for using.

Pequi do cerrado, buriti da vereda e ace.en: Cerrado pequi, vereda buriti and backyard acerola! That's just it. I'll make my three-root syrup.

Em troca, leve isto. Era da Dona Buriti,.en: In return, take this. It belonged to Dona Buriti, my student, from before she opened her gym in Vila Buriti. It teaches a creature to strike with the strength of the ages.

Ainda faltam frutos: um pequi, um buriti.en: Still missing fruit: a pequi, a buriti and an acerola. There's pequi in the cerrado and the Pantanal, buriti in the Vereda and acerola around, hidden in the bushes.

Quer me ajudar, menino? Para o meu xarop.en: Will you help me, child? For my three-root syrup I need a pequi, a buriti and an acerola. My legs don't go that far anymore.

Ajudar a raizeira com os três frutos?.en: Help the herbalist with the three fruits?

Deus lhe pague. Traga quando achar, sem.en: Bless you. Bring them when you find them, no rush: healing plants are never in a hurry.

Tudo bem. A porta fica aberta..en: All right. The door stays open.

O tacho está cheio de doce de buriti gra.en: The pot is full of buriti preserves thanks to you! Come back whenever sadness strikes. Or hunger.

Três frutos de buriti, maduros que só! A.en: Three buriti fruits, ripe as can be! Now we can make the preserves. Hand them over and I'll put them in the pot.

Leve rapadura para a viagem e garapa par.en: Take brown sugar for the trip and cane juice for thirst. A tired creature levels up with brown sugar, you know?

Ô, meu filho, a receita do doce de burit.en: Oh, dear, the buriti preserves recipe calls for three fruits and the Vereda's buriti grove is full of critters. I'm too old to be fighting Antão.

Se você achar três frutos de buriti por.en: If you find three buriti fruits around, bring them here. I'll pay in brown sugar, the strongest currency in the Sertão.

A Açucena mandou dizer que vem para a fe.en: Açucena says she's coming to the São João festival in the Arraial! I'm already tuning the viola. And my heart.

Resposta dela?! Deixa eu ler… \"Volte qu.en: Her reply?! Let me read… "Come back when your viola learns my song." She wrote the song underneath!

Vinte anos esperando essa moda. Tome, é.en: Twenty years waiting for that song. Here, it's the scroll my father won at a singing contest. It teaches you to vanish like longing.

O meu Bem-te-viço está no seu ombro, com.en: My Bem-te-viço is on your shoulder, with the letter on its foot. Take it to Porto Pantaneiro, the wide house next to the Post. It only gets off your shoulder when it sees Açucena.

Você vai para os lados de Porto Pantanei.en: Are you headed toward Porto Pantaneiro, Champion? I have a letter for Dona Açucena. I wrote it twenty years ago and never had the courage to send it.

O correio do Sertão é por ave: o meu Bem.en: The Sertão mail goes by bird: my Bem-te-viço carries the letter tied to its foot and rides on your shoulder all the way. It doesn't fight, doesn't eat much and sings in the morning.

Levar a carta do violeiro para Porto Pan.en: Take the fiddler's letter to Porto Pantaneiro?

O Bem-te-viço do violeiro pousou no ombr.en: The fiddler's Bem-te-viço landed on {JOGADOR}'s shoulder, with the letter rolled around its foot.

Porto Pantaneiro fica no fim do canal do.en: Porto Pantaneiro is at the end of the Pantanal canal, downriver. Tell her it's from Zabelê. She'll know.

Tudo bem. Esperei vinte anos, espero mai.en: That's fine. I waited twenty years, I can wait another week.

O Bem-te-viço desce do ombro de {JOGADOR.en: The Bem-te-viço hops off {JOGADOR}'s shoulder, lands on the table and holds out the foot with the letter.

Um Bem-te-viço de Vila Cascavel… essa le.en: A Bem-te-viço from Vila Cascavel… I know this handwriting. It's Zabelê's! Twenty years and his handwriting hasn't changed.

Espere aí, que eu escrevo a resposta ago.en: Hold on, I'll write the reply right now. And I'll send the song I wrote for him. He never could play it.

O Bem-te-viço voltou para o ombro de {JO.en: The Bem-te-viço went back to {JOGADOR}'s shoulder with the reply tied to its foot.

Já respondi. Agora é com ele. E com a vi.en: I've replied. Now it's up to him. And the viola.

Moro aqui há vinte anos. Costuro, canto.en: I've lived here twenty years. I sew, I sing and I wait for a letter from Vila Cascavel. The letter never comes.

O casal de Tuiuiú voltou ao ninho e os o.en: The Tuiuiú couple came back to the nest and the eggs are all whole. Thanks to you, child.

Um dia inteiro e nenhum ovo sumiu! O pes.en: A whole day and not one egg went missing! Folks say they saw you on the roof chasing off vultures.

Tome: Cuia de Mel, que filhote ama, e es.en: Here: a Honey Gourd, which babies love, and this scroll my late husband won at a rodeo.

Ainda não virou o dia, menino. Ninho de.en: The day isn't over yet, child. A Tuiuiú nest is watched from sunup to sundown. Come back tomorrow and tell me.

O casal de Tuiuiú do meu telhado saiu pa.en: The Tuiuiú couple on my roof went fishing in the Pantanal and I need to go to Porto Pantaneiro. Who's going to watch the eggs?

Vigiar o ninho da Dona Brejeira até aman.en: Watch Dona Brejeira's nest until tomorrow?

Fique de olho no céu: urubu, gavião e ge.en: Keep an eye on the sky: vultures, hawks and people in rust-colored overalls. Come back tomorrow, I'll be home by then.

Tudo bem. Eu peço para a Jandira. Ela va.en: That's fine. I'll ask Jandira. She'll sleep on the roof, but she'll do it.

Sou a Drª Taiamã, veterinária do Centro..en: I'm Dr. Taiamã, the Center's vet. Our hands are tied: the Rust Cartel is raiding the southern rookery.

Quando os ninhos estiverem seguros, os f.en: Once the nests are safe, the babies they stole will come here. And they'll need someone to look after them.

Hoje você já adotou um filhote. Um por d.en: You already adopted a baby today. One per day, so each one gets real attention. Come back tomorrow!

Os filhotes resgatados do Cartel estão c.en: The babies rescued from the Cartel are growing! Loose in the wild they wouldn't survive: they learned to live in cages.

Com um treinador eles aprendem a caçar,.en: With a trainer they learn to hunt, swim and fly. One baby a day, deal? That way each one gets attention.

E não se preocupe com o tamanho: aqui el.en: And don't worry about size: here they eat well and train with us. They leave almost at your team's pace.

Todos os filhotes já têm treinador! Você.en: Every baby has a trainer now! You were amazing. The Center has never been so empty, and that's wonderful.

Cuide bem dele. E traga para visitar: a.en: Take good care of it. And bring it to visit: the keeper is going to miss it like crazy.

As suas fotos estão no mural da Estação.en: Your photos are on the Research Station board! Biologist Ingá cried. So did I.

Cinco ninhos! Vereda, cerrado duas vezes.en: Five nests! The Vereda, the cerrado twice, Morro do Urucum and the Pantanal Grande pasture. Without touching a single one!

Fique com a câmera, ela é sua. E com est.en: Keep the camera, it's yours. And these feathers I picked up off the ground: a fallen feather is a gift.

Faltam ninhos! Um na Vereda dos Buritis,.en: Still missing nests! One in Vereda dos Buritis, two here in the cerrado, one in Pantanal Alagado, near Morro do Urucum, and one in the Pantanal Grande pasture.

Psiu! Estou fazendo o censo dos ninhos d.en: Psst! I'm doing the Sertão nest census for the Research Station, but my knees don't climb termite mounds anymore.

Fotografar cinco ninhos para a observado.en: Photograph five nests for the birdwatcher?

Leve a minha câmera. Regra de ouro: olha.en: Take my camera. Golden rule: look, photograph and leave. A touched nest is an abandoned nest.

Tem um na Vereda dos Buritis, dois aqui.en: There's one in Vereda dos Buritis, two here in the cerrado, one in Pantanal Alagado, near Morro do Urucum, and one in the Pantanal Grande pasture.

Quando mudar de ideia, estarei aqui. Imó.en: When you change your mind, I'll be here. Motionless. Birdwatchers learn to wait.

na ilha do Morro do Urucum.en: on the Morro do Urucum island

no pé de buriti do pasto de Pantanal Gra.en: under the buriti tree in the Pantanal Grande pasture

E o Tucanuçu, como vai lá em Pantanal… a.en: And how's the Tucanuçu doing over in Pantanal… oh, no, it's with me. It's Corisco who's with you! Does he behave?

Viajante! Eu crio emas e troco com quem.en: Traveler! I raise rheas and trade with passersby. A critter that travels learns more.

Ando querendo um Tucanuçu, desses de bic.en: I've been wanting a Tucanuçu, the kind with a flaming beak. In exchange I'll give you my Emaçu, Corisco. He runs faster than the train and he's holding an Ointment.

Trocar o seu Tucanuçu pelo Emaçu Corisco.en: Trade your Tucanuçu for the Emaçu Corisco?

{JOGADOR} trocou o Tucanuçu pelo Emaçu C.en: {JOGADOR} traded the Tucanuçu for the Emaçu Corisco!

Cuide bem dele! Criatura trocada aprende.en: Take good care of him! A traded creature learns faster, but only obeys if you have the badges for it. You've got plenty.

Tudo bem. Proposta não vence..en: That's fine. The offer doesn't expire.

Tucanuçu tem muito na Vereda dos Buritis.en: There are lots of Tucanuçu in Vereda dos Buritis, to the north. Catch one and come back; Corisco will wait.

Alto lá! Ninhal cercado: propriedade do.en: Halt! Fenced-off rookery: property of the Rust Cartel, by order of Colonel Garrote. Barbed wire, hear me? Barbed!

Esses ovos de tuiuiú vão descer o rio no.en: These tuiuiú eggs are going downriver on the next boat. Out there they pay a fortune for Pantanal critters in golden cages. And you… you're that Champion who crushed Lata and bent Rebite. Well, with me you'll get all wired up!

Desenrolou… Arame velho, esse meu..en: Unwound… This wire of mine is old.

Fique com o seu ninhal! A rede do canal.en: Keep your rookery! I'll leave you the net in the south canal as a souvenir. Oh, no: the Police will take it down. Whatever! But remember my name: Rebite is waiting for you in Chapada Rubra. And he doesn't forget an insult.

O tenente Arame fugiu pelo canal, com os.en: Lieutenant Arame fled down the canal, with his goons behind him. Zefa's ranch hands put the eggs back in the nests, one by one. The tuiuiús land in the rookery again.

Campeão! A rede do Cartel saiu do canal.en: Champion! The Cartel's net is out of the south canal and the Estrada Vermelha gate is going to open. Porto Pantaneiro is free again! Zefa sent this as thanks. She said it's for "someone who isn't afraid of mud".

Os filhotes que o Cartel tirou dos ninho.en: The babies the Cartel took from the nests went to the Pantanal Grande Rehabilitation Center. Dr. Taiamã is looking for people to adopt them.

A gaiola está vazia e aberta. No fundo f.en: The cage is empty and open. All that's left at the bottom is a wisp of macaw feather.

Uma gaiola do Cartel Ferrugem com filhot.en: A Rust Cartel cage with Ararinha chicks huddled together. The padlock has a rusty gear symbol. The lieutenant has the key.

Ô menino! Desamarra aqui… não, primeiro.en: Hey, kid! Untie me… no, first get this screwball out of my mine!

Quieto aí, garimpeiro! VOCÊ! O moleque d.en: Quiet, prospector! YOU! The kid from the Lighthouse! I got demoted to mine lieutenant because of you! Down here there are forty eggs from the rookery, twelve macaw chicks and one stubborn prospector. All mine. Get out or get screwed in!

Espanou… a rosca espanou de novo! O Coro.en: Stripped… the thread stripped again! The Colonel's going to send me to Brejo Roxo to clean tanks.

Fique com a mina, com o garimpeiro e com.en: Keep the mine, the prospector and the critters! I'm… I'm going to the surface. By the stairs. Which I hate.

As gaiolas se abrem uma a uma. As Ararin.en: The cages open one by one. The Ararinhas fly down the tunnel toward the light, and the rookery eggs go into a lined straw basket.

Ufa! Três dias amarrado ouvindo esse suj.en: Phew! Three days tied up listening to that guy whistle off-key. Thanks, Champion. The mine belongs to the plateau folks again. The eggs go back to the Pantanal on the first boat, and the chicks that can't fly go to the Rehabilitation Center.

Agora eu vou subir, tomar um banho de ba.en: Now I'm going up, take a gold-pan bath and open the gym. Come challenge me whenever you like: mine carts, switches and raw stone. And don't think I'll go easy on you just because you untied me!

O salão está quieto. O chão ainda é morn.en: The chamber is quiet. The floor is still warm, and the walls have fire marks shaped like a serpent.

No fundo do salão, uma serpente de fogo.en: At the back of the chamber, a fire serpent sleeps coiled on the rock. Its breathing makes the lava bubble. It doesn't even open its eyes. It seems to be waiting for someone with the strength of Chapada Rubra.

A serpente de fogo abre os olhos. O salã.en: The fire serpent opens its eyes. The whole chamber lights up as if the sun had entered the cave.

O BOITATÁ desperta, sentindo a Insígnia.en: BOITATÁ awakens, sensing the Crystal Badge!

O Boitatá se acomodou na cuia, morno com.en: Boitatá settled into the gourd, warm as embers in a stove.

O Boitatá se desfez em brasas e afundou.en: Boitatá crumbled into embers and sank into the lava. The cave cooled for good: it was never seen again.

O Boitatá se enrola de novo sobre a pedr.en: Boitatá coils up on the rock again, eyes half open. It's still there, waiting.

{JOGADOR}!! Eu sabia que você ia subir a.en: {JOGADOR}!! I knew you'd climb the plateau this way. I came up the vine too, but I fell twice.

Ganhei! Ganhei do Campeão da Liga! Anota.en: I won! I beat the League Champion! Write that down, Rádio Cipó! But… your team is tired from the climb. It doesn't count that much. Go to the Post and come back so I can win again.

Sabe o que eu descobri no Sertão? Que pe.en: Know what I figured out in the Sertão? That losing to you doesn't hurt so much anymore. Just a little. That's progress.

A Labareda acende as fogueiras do ginási.en: Labareda lights the gym's bonfires in the order of a song. I got the note wrong three times. Good luck, and don't tell anyone I gave you a hint.

O melhor marcador de quadrilha que o Arr.en: The best square-dance caller the Arraial has ever had! Come back every Saturday: the mulled drink is free and the bunting is paper.

A festa de São João é no sábado, no terr.en: The São João festival is on Saturday, in the yard. Bonfire, square dance, peanut brittle and mulled drink.

Volte no sábado que eu preciso de um mar.en: Come back Saturday, I need a caller for the square dance. Seu Anarriê retired and the accordion won't wait.

É SÁBADO! Dia de São João! E o marcador.en: IT'S SATURDAY! São João day! And the square-dance caller has vanished. Will you call it for us? Just answer right at each step!

O sanfoneiro puxa o baião. O que o marca.en: The accordionist strikes up the baião. What does the caller shout first?

Os pares balançaram. Agora vem a pegadin.en: The couples swayed. Now comes the square-dance prank:

Todos gritam \"Olha a cobra!\". E a resp.en: Everyone shouts "Watch out, snake!". And the answer is…

É MENTIRA! Isso, marcador! O terreiro in.en: IT'S A LIE! That's it, caller! The whole yard burst out laughing and the bonfire leaped up high!

Tome o seu prêmio de São João: Pedra Sol.en: Here's your São João prize: a Sun Stone, which Smith Labareda says holds the bonfire's heat, and peanut brittle. I mean, brown sugar. We ran out of peanut brittle.

Não, não! Quando gritam \"olha a cobra\".en: No, no! When they shout "watch out, snake", the answer is that it's a lie! Breathe and try again.

A pegadinha é a cobra, marcador! Tente d.en: The prank is the snake, caller! Try again, the square dance is waiting.

Começa com o balancê, marcador! Balançar.en: It starts with the balancê, caller! Sway first, run later. Try again.

Três pepitas na minha coleção nova! Agor.en: Three nuggets for my new collection! Now I have eleven. I mean, I have three, plus eight of fool's gold.

Três pepitas! Brilho de verdade, não é p.en: Three nuggets! Real shine, not fool's gold! Let me bite one to check… it's gold!

Trato é trato: um pergaminho por três pe.en: A deal's a deal: one scroll for three nuggets. This one teaches a creature to slide the earth right onto the enemy.

Eu troco um pergaminho raro por três pep.en: I'll trade a rare scroll for three nuggets. Nuggets come from cracked rocks: on Estrada Vermelha, here on the plateau and in Mina Velha. Smash them and look!

As Cuias de Ouro saíram perfeitas. Brasa.en: The Gold Gourds came out perfect. Boitatá embers never miss.

Você viu o Boitatá?! Então você sabe o q.en: You saw Boitatá?! Then you know what real fire is. With the embers it leaves on the rock I can forge anything.

Dar uma pepita ao Ferreiro Malho para el.en: Give a nugget to Smith Malho so he can forge gourds?

Ouro derretido no fogo do Boitatá e mold.en: Gold melted in Boitatá's fire and molded on a calabash shell… Done! Gold Gourds, five at once!

Guarde, então. Ouro guardado também é ou.en: Keep it, then. Gold in the pocket is still gold.

Traga uma pepita que eu derreto no fogo.en: Bring me a nugget and I'll melt it in Boitatá's fire and make you gold gourds.

A Forja Grande faz sino, ferradura e fac.en: The Great Forge makes bells, horseshoes and machetes. But the fire here is too weak for gold.

Dizem que o Boitatá, lá na Caverna Vulcâ.en: They say Boitatá, over in Caverna Vulcânica, leaves embers that never go out. Whoever finds the fire serpent and comes back in one piece, come see me.

A porta ao norte se abriu. No Salão ning.en: The north door has opened. Nobody heals you for free in the Hall: if you need to, use the medicine in your bag before moving on.

Os Guardiões falam de você com a voz bai.en: The Guardians speak of you in the hushed voice reserved for the elders, {JOGADOR}. The Hall stays open to anyone who wants to test their strength again. And they say that with every win of yours, a wanderer climbs up to the Summit stone. Nobody knows where he comes from.

Dezesseis insígnias. O portão reconheceu.en: Sixteen badges. The gate recognized you before I did. Up there is the Council Hall: five Guardians, five battles, no door back. I left an offering by the gate exit: two Elixirs and two Guaraná Teas. Take them.

Mais uma coisa. Hoje cedo passou um home.en: One more thing. Early today a man came by in a leather hat and iron boots, with two goons. Said he came to "do business with the Council". The Council doesn't do business. Be careful at the Summit.

Ora, ora. O herói das dezesseis insígnia.en: Well, well. The hero of sixteen badges. The Power Plant, the Lighthouse, the Pantanal, the Mine, the Lab… always you. Know why I climbed all the way up here? Because the Council Hall keeps the oldest creatures in Pingorama. With one of them in a cage, the Rust Cartel will never need a power plant again.

Acorrentei as argolas da porta. Os velho.en: I've chained the door rings. The old folks in there will deal with me, or they're never coming out. And you? Will you get out of my way, or be the last critter in my collection?

Perdi… para um moleque com um Diário de.en: Beaten… by a kid with a Field Journal and a bag full of medicine.

As portas de pedra do Salão se abrem por.en: The Hall's stone doors open from the inside, chains and all. Four Guardians come down the stairs in silence.

Garrote. A montanha avisou que você vinh.en: Garrote. The mountain warned us you were coming. The mountain also warned us who was coming after you.

As criaturas que o Cartel prendeu nesses.en: The creatures the Cartel locked up all these years are already back in their rivers, nests and forests. All that's left is for you to go back down to the plains — and answer for what you did.

…O Cartel Ferrugem acabou. Mas o mundo é.en: …The Rust Cartel is finished. But the world is big, Guardian.

Os Guardiões da planície levaram o Coron.en: The Guardians of the plains took the Colonel. The chains stayed on the ground, where they belong. We're going back to our rooms, {JOGADOR}. When you're ready, the door is open. Once inside, there's no turning back.

\"Edição extraordinária do Rádio Cipó! O.en: "Rádio Cipó special edition! Colonel Garrote, boss of the Rust Cartel, has been arrested on Pico Pingorama! The Guardians confirm it: the Cartel is finished. Researchers on both maps are celebrating — and Dr. Buriti says she's going to sleep eight hours straight for the first time in years!"

{JOGADOR}! Espera! Eu subi a trilha corr.en: {JOGADOR}! Wait! I ran all the way up the trail from Serra da Geada! I've got all sixteen too, you know? Won the last one yesterday. But I'm not going in before you. It wouldn't be fair… and I want to see your face when you come out.

Ganhei! Ganhei na porta do Conselho! …Ma.en: I won! I won at the Council's door! …But look at your team: tired and smiling. Go rest at the Post and come back. I'll wait out here for the result.

Desde aquele dia no laboratório, cada ve.en: Ever since that day at the lab, every time I lost to you I got stronger. I think that was the best gift you ever gave me.

Entra lá, Campeão da Costa e do Sertão..en: Go on in, Champion of the Coast and the Sertão. And when you come out, we'll go fishing together at Lagoa Gelada. The pine nuts are on me.

Desafiante! Daqui para dentro é o Consel.en: Challenger! Beyond this point is the Council of Guardians: the Sea Guardian, the Forest Guardian, the Sky Guardian, the Earth Guardian and the High Guardian. The door closes behind you. Nobody heals you for free inside, only what fits in your bag. If your team falls, the Guardians will bring you back to the Gate, and the Council starts over from the first room.

Entrar no Salão do Conselho agora? (Não.en: Enter the Council Hall now? (There's no going back.)

A porta de pedra fechou. Na sala de espe.en: The stone door has closed. In the waiting room, light pours through the cracks in the ceiling like water.

Sem pressa. O Posto do acampamento fica.en: No rush. The camp's Post is just below the Gate. Come back when you're ready.

Esta é a sala de espera. Olhe a equipe e.en: This is the waiting room. Check your team and bag calmly: from here up, every room is a battle. First room: Iara Costa, River and Charm. Second: Cauã, Grass and Bug. Third: Jandaia, Wind and Thunder. Fourth: Moacir, Earth, Stone and Iron.

Na quinta sala está o Guardião-Mor Arand.en: In the fifth room is High Guardian Arandu. He fights with a bit of everything, and saves for last a creature you only see in stories. Good luck. All of Pingorama is listening to your footsteps.

Chegou molhado de névoa. Bom: a água gos.en: You came in wet with mist. Good: water likes those who are already wet.

O Cauã luta com a mata inteira: raiz, ca.en: Cauã fights with the whole forest: root, shell and wing. Fire and wind clear a path, but he has thick bark for that.

Já me venceu, desafiante. A porta está a.en: You've already beaten me, challenger. The door is open: Cauã's forest awaits.

Pisou na minha sala sem quebrar um galho.en: You stepped into my room without snapping a twig. That's a good start.

A Jandaia manda no céu. Pedra e Geada de.en: Jandaia rules the sky. Stone and Frost bring down what flies; Earth just can't reach whoever's up high.

A mata já abriu caminho. Siga para o céu.en: The forest has already made way. On to the sky.

Ventou lá fora quando você abriu a porta.en: The wind blew outside when you opened the door. The sky likes you. I haven't decided yet.

O Moacir é a montanha. Água e raiz amole.en: Moacir is the mountain. Water and roots soften stone; Ember bends his iron — but he has an answer for almost everything.

O céu está limpo para você. A terra espe.en: The sky is clear for you. The earth waits in the next room.

Quatro salas, e você ainda caminha. A pe.en: Four rooms, and you're still walking. Stone respects those who walk.

Atrás daquela porta está o Arandu. Ele n.en: Behind that door is Arandu. He doesn't have a type: he has the memory of them all. And he saves the thunder hawk for last.

A terra já tremeu por você. Vá: o Guardi.en: The earth has already shaken for you. Go: the High Guardian doesn't like to wait.

Entre, {JOGADOR}. Sente no chão um insta.en: Come in, {JOGADOR}. Sit on the floor a moment: here the floor is the highest thing in Pingorama. Four Guardians opened their doors to you. I am the last door. And the last door is always the heaviest.

Ainda não. Mas eu vi a sua equipe se col.en: Not yet. But I saw your team step in front of you, one after another. That's what the Council looks for. Go down, rest and come back. The mountain isn't going anywhere.

Os Guardiões trouxeram você de volta ao.en: The Guardians brought you back to the Guardians' Gate and took care of your team. The Council starts over from the first room. The camp's Post is just past the gate, if you want to restock your bag.

De novo, {JOGADOR}. E melhor que da prim.en: Again, {JOGADOR}. And better than the first time. The Memory Marker gets one more notch beside your name.

Dizem que o andarilho voltou a subir até.en: They say the wanderer has climbed up to the Summit stone again. He always shows up after someone beats us. Go see.

Venha comigo. Há uma sala acima desta on.en: Come with me. There's a room above this one that only those the Council recognizes may enter.

Este é o Marco da Memória. Cada nome aqu.en: This is the Memory Marker. Every name here belongs to someone who climbed for everyone: for the critters of the rivers, the forests, the skies and the stones. Today the Marker gets your name, {JOGADOR}, and your team's names beside it. Costa do Sol and the Sertão das Névoas have a new Guardian.

Os Guardiões cuidaram da sua equipe: tod.en: The Guardians took care of your team: all of them up, rested and proud.

Agora as portas que estavam fechadas se.en: Now the doors that were shut are opening. The Forest Guardian, in Planalto Lume, already knows you're coming: Floresta Ancestral will welcome you. And do you feel the ground? Two creatures that only walk the land after the Council recognizes someone have just woken up: the wolf of the moon and the jaguar of the sun. They'll roam both maps.

\"Atenção, Pingorama! O Rádio Cipó inter.en: "Attention, Pingorama! Rádio Cipó interrupts everything — even the fiddle tunes — to announce: {JOGADOR}, from Vila Jacarandá, has beaten the Council of Guardians on Pico Pingorama! Prof. Ipê cried into the microphone, Mom is already baking a cake and Tainá says she's coming for the title next week. Congratulations, Guardian!"

A porta ao norte se abriu. Aqui dentro n.en: The north door has opened. Nobody heals you for free in here: if you need to, use items from your bag before moving on.

Uma faixa na porta: \"A Liga descansa. O.en: A banner on the door: "The League is resting. Champion {JOGADOR} has already been through." Rematches with the Masters by appointment only, over Rádio Cipó.

Desafiante! Daqui para dentro é a Liga d.en: Challenger! Beyond this point is the League of Guardians: four Masters and the Champion, one after another. The door locks behind you. There's no healing inside, only what you carry in your bag. If your team falls, you come back to this yard and start over from the first Master.

Entrar na Liga agora? (Não há volta.).en: Enter the League now? (There's no going back.)

A porta trancou. À frente, a sala de esp.en: The door has locked. Ahead lies the waiting room and, after it, the tide.

Sem pressa. O Posto e a Venda estão logo.en: No rush. The Post and the Shop are right over there: heal your team, stock up your bag and save your journey.

Esta é a sala de espera. Respire. Olhe a.en: This is the waiting room. Breathe. Check your team, check your bag. First room: Master Maré, River and Poison. Second: Smith Brasa-Viva, Ember and Iron. Third: Shaman Neblina, Mind and Spook. Fourth: Tamer Pampa, Normal and Brawl.

Na quinta sala está o Cacique Aracê, Cam.en: In the fifth room waits Chief Aracê, Champion of Costa do Sol for twenty years. Whoever beats the Chief enters the Hall of Fame and earns the right to cross the mountains. Good luck, challenger!

Pisou devagar, hein? Faz bem. No mangue.en: Stepped in slowly, huh? Smart. In the mangrove, whoever runs sinks.

Vá com a maré a favor. O Brasa-Viva bate.en: Go with the tide in your favor. Brasa-Viva hits hard, but hot iron bends too: water, earth and a good kick do the trick.

Já me venceu, desafiante. A porta está a.en: You've already beaten me, challenger. The door is open: don't let Brasa-Viva's iron cool down.

Chegou cheirando a maresia. Venceu a Mar.en: You came in smelling of sea breeze. So you beat Maré. In here, water boils away!

O Pajé Neblina não bate: ele embaralha..en: Shaman Neblina doesn't hit: he scrambles. Spook-type creatures hit his squarely — but his have Spook moves too.

Sino rachado não toca duas vezes. Siga,.en: A cracked bell doesn't ring twice. Go on, the fog won't wait.

Hum… duas vitórias e o passo ainda firme.en: Hmm… two wins and your step is still steady. Let's see if your head keeps up with your legs.

A Pampa luta de perto e no compasso. Ven.en: Pampa fights up close and on the beat. Wind, Mind and Charm knock the ground out from under Brawl. And Spook… well, she has an answer for Spook.

Você já ouviu a minha história até o fim.en: You've heard my story to the very end. The next one is Pampa's.

Três Mestres no chão! Aqui o chão é meu,.en: Three Masters down! Here the ground is mine, partner. Climb into the saddle!

Agora é com o Cacique. Ele não tem um ti.en: Now it's up to the Chief. He doesn't have a type: he has a plan. And he saves Pirarucão for last — Charm and Frost get Legend good.

Passa, passa! O Campeão não gosta de esp.en: Go on, go on! The Champion doesn't like to wait, and I don't like seeing good folks standing still.

Entre. Tire o pó da estrada dos ombros e.en: Come in. Dust the road off your shoulders and look around: every statue in this room was someone who got where you are.

Ainda não é o seu amanhecer, {JOGADOR}..en: It's not your dawn yet, {JOGADOR}. But I saw your team look at you before they fell: that can't be trained. Come back. The League starts over, and I'll be here, as always.

Os Guardiões levaram a sua equipe de vol.en: The Guardians carried your team back to the Platô yard and took care of them. The League starts over from the first Master. Stop by the Post, restock your bag and try again when you're ready.

Venha comigo, {JOGADOR}. Há uma sala nes.en: Come with me, {JOGADOR}. There's a room on this Platô that only two people enter each generation: the Champion who leaves and the Champion who arrives.

Este é o Hall da Fama. Hoje o Marco ganh.en: This is the Hall of Fame. Today the Marker gets a new name: {JOGADOR}, Champion of Costa do Sol! And beside your name go theirs — because nobody climbs this Platô alone.

Os Guardiões do Hall cuidaram da sua equ.en: The Hall's Guardians took care of your team: all of them up and rested.

O título abre o que estava fechado. A li.en: The title opens what was closed. The mountain line and the great river are too dangerous for anyone who hasn't proven what you proved today.

O Passe vale no Trem Serra-Sol, em Porto.en: The Pass is good on the Serra-Sol Train, in Porto Sereia. The Ticket, on the Saveiro from Cidade Coral. Both lead to the Sertão das Névoas, where there are eight more badges — and people worse than power-plant goons. And every Champion takes a stone from our collection home from the Platô. Pick yours.

O Passe é do Trem Serra-Sol, em Porto Se.en: The Pass is for the Serra-Sol Train, in Porto Sereia. The Ticket, for the Saveiro from Cidade Coral. Both lead to the Sertão das Névoas, where there are eight more badges — and people worse than power-plant goons. Just don't rush to the station: the mountain line and the Saveiro are under repair. Keep both; they're good as soon as they reopen. And every Champion takes a stone from our collection home from the Platô. Pick yours.

Qual Pedra de Evolução você quer?.en: Which Evolution Stone do you want?

\"Interrompemos a moda de viola para uma.en: "We interrupt this fiddle tune for news from the Platô: Costa do Sol has a new Champion! {JOGADOR}, from Vila Jacarandá, has won the League of Guardians! With that, the Sertão das Névoas region is now open: the Serra-Sol Train and the Saveiro are taking the Champion aboard again. Safe travels, and bring a coat!"

"We interrupt this fiddle tune for news from the Platô: Costa do Sol has a new Champion! {JOGADOR}, from Vila Jacarandá, has won the League of Guardians! The trip to the Sertão das Névoas will have to wait a little: the Serra-Sol Train and the Saveiro are still under repair, and this station will let you know when they reopen. Until then, all of Costa do Sol wants to meet the Champion!"

Ouviu? Agora é oficial. Vá ver o sol nas.en: Hear that? Now it's official. Go watch the sun rise on the other side of the mountains, Champion. The Platô stays with me a little longer.

Ouviu? Agora é oficial. Enquanto a serra.en: Hear that? Now it's official. Until the mountains open, walk the Coast with the title on your chest: there are creatures you haven't seen yet and people who'll want a rematch. The Platô stays with me a little longer.

GANHEI DO CAMPEÃO! Ouviu, Platô?! …Tá, v.en: I BEAT THE CHAMPION! Hear that, Platô?! …Fine, you were tired from five battles. I know. But I won.

Sabe o que eu descobri, {JOGADOR}? Que e.en: You know what I figured out, {JOGADOR}? I spent eight badges wanting to beat you, and you spent eight badges taking care of your creatures. I'm going back in there to beat that League my own way. And then, when the mountain line reopens, I'm taking the train. The Rust Cartel ran off to the sertão, and I still have a score to settle with people who cage creatures.

Te vejo do outro lado da serra, Campeão..en: See you on the other side of the mountains, Champion. And don't get used to the title: I told you I'm next.

Como vai a criatura que eu te confiei? E.en: How's the creature I entrusted to you? She used to sit by the window every day, watching the road. I think she was waiting for you. When you cross the mountains, send news: all I know of the Sertão das Névoas is what the drovers tell.

{JOGADOR}! A Ipê falou tanto de você nas.en: {JOGADOR}! Ipê talked about you so much in her letters I already knew you by heart. And now with the Leaf Badge in your case! Ever since that day in her lab, I've had one of the creatures that stayed on the table. Ipê asked me to give it only to someone who took good care of the first one.

Ela ainda é pequena, mas aprende depress.en: She's still small, but she learns fast next to a team like yours. They say the third creature from that table was born again from an egg on Praia das Tartarugas. But that's a matter for the tide, not the vereda.

Bem-vindo ao laboratório de campo! Eu so.en: Welcome to the field lab! I'm Dr. Buriti: I study veredas, marshes and everything that sings at night. I'm keeping a creature for a trainer I can trust. Come back with the Leaf Badge, from this village's gym, and we'll talk.

Leve ao Seu Jatobá, o dono do Parque Saf.en: Take it to Seu Jatobá, the owner of the Safari Park, up in Vale do Buriti-Alto. The cart track from the League Platô goes up there.

Ô, Campeão! Parabéns pela Liga! Eu sou o.en: Hey, Champion! Congrats on the League! I'm Tião, from the ox cart.

Lá em cima, na trilha do leste, fica o V.en: Up there, on the east trail, is Vale do Buriti-Alto: it has the Creature Games and Seu Jatobá's Safari Park. Only Champions go up, the trail's a rough one.

Subir de carro de boi para o Vale do Bur.en: Ride the ox cart up to Vale do Buriti-Alto?

Chegamos! Quando quiser descer, é só fal.en: We're here! When you want to go down, just talk to me here at the entrance.

O boi espera. Ele é paciente; eu também..en: The ox will wait. He's patient; so am I.

Descer para o Platô da Liga?.en: Go down to the League Platô?

Aproveite o vale. Dizem que a Juíza Bia.en: Enjoy the valley. They say Judge Bia runs faster than the creatures.

Ponto de prova vale prêmio! Vitamina de.en: Games points win prizes! Fruit shakes, evolution stones, scrolls and brown sugar. No betting: here you only win by running.

Criatura cansada de prova não rende. Dei.en: A creature worn out from the trials won't perform. Let me bless them with rue and buriti water.

Pronto: todo mundo inteirinho. Vai com f.en: There: everyone's good as new. Go with faith and with breath.

Bem-vindo ao Parque Safári do Buriti-Alt.en: Welcome to the Buriti-Alto Safari Park! No battling here: creatures are wild and stay wild until you form a partnership.

Lá dentro você tem ISCA (ela come e foge.en: Inside you have BAIT (it eats and flees less, but the gourd works worse), ROCK (it gets angry: the gourd works better, but it flees more) and CLOSER (creeping up slowly helps the gourd).

Entrada: 500 patacas, 30 Cuias-Safári e.en: Entry: 500 patacas, 30 Safari Gourds and 500 steps. Going in?

As criaturas só aparecem no capim alto d.en: Creatures only show up in the park's tall grass. Each sector has its own critters, by day and by night.

Os passos acabam? O passeio acaba. As cu.en: Out of steps? The outing's over. Out of gourds? Same. Walked out the gate? That too. Any Safari Gourds left over stay here with me.

O parque só tem a Vereda por enquanto. O.en: For now the park only has the Vereda. Seu Jatobá builds the other sectors with what folks bring: river stones, buriti saplings, hollow logs… Talk to him over at the house.

Aqui estão as 30 Cuias-Safári. Boa caçad.en: Here are your 30 Safari Gourds. Happy hunting… I mean, happy partnering! Tweeet, gate's open!

Faltam patacas, criatura. A entrada é 50.en: Not enough patacas, buddy. Entry is 500, and the park needs grass and food for the critters.

Tá certo. A porteira fica aqui esperando.en: All right. The gate will be right here waiting.

Sou guia do parque. Dica de quem anda no.en: I'm a park guide. Tip from someone who walks the grass: the Rock makes a critter angry and easier to catch, but it flees more. Use it when you have gourds to spare.

E o Seu Jatobá quer material para os set.en: And Seu Jatobá wants materials for the new sectors: river stones, which a fisher on Trilha dos Cipós collects by the river; buriti saplings, from the nursery keeper in Vila Buriti; and hollow logs, from the woodcutter on Estrada do Buriti.

Ô, Campeão! Sabe o que este rio faz? Rol.en: Hey, Champion! Know what this river does? It rolls stones. Rolls them so much they come out smooth and round, perfect for lining a bank.

O Seu Jatobá do Safári anda pedindo pedr.en: Seu Jatobá from the Safari has been asking for river stones for his new lagoon. Here, the prettiest one I found.

Essa pedra que te dei veio de três cacho.en: That stone I gave you came from three waterfalls upstream. It took longer than I did to get here.

Buriti é a árvore da água: onde ele nasc.en: Buriti is the water tree: where it sprouts, the marsh comes along, and the critters follow.

Esta muda é das boas. Planta na beira de.en: This sapling is a good one. Plant it by running water and talk to it now and then.

A muda pegou? Buriti demora, mas quando.en: Did the sapling take? Buriti is slow, but once it's rooted no drought can knock it down.

Eu só corto árvore que já caiu, viu? E e.en: I only cut trees that have already fallen, you know? And this one fell hollow: an owl used to live inside.

Tronco oco é casa pronta. O Seu Jatobá f.en: A hollow log is a ready-made home. Seu Jatobá said he wants to make a den for the night critters at the Safari. Take it, it's light.

Tronco oco é casa de coruja, de urutau,.en: A hollow log is home to owls, potoos, possums… Night critters like dark and quiet.

Campeã da Costa, campeã da Costa… aqui n.en: Coast Champion, Coast Champion… out here in the Sertão critters are born big! Let's see you hold on!

Aguentou. E ainda sorriu..en: You held on. And you even smiled.

Os selvagens daqui são do tamanho da Lig.en: The wild ones here are League-sized. Stop by the Vila Cascavel Post whenever you can.

Lagoa do Chapéu Perdido, peixe achado! V.en: Lost Hat Lagoon, found fish! Let's see if you take the bait.

Quem mordeu fui eu..en: Turns out I'm the one who got hooked.

Vara Boa aqui pega Dourado-Rei. Vara Vel.en: A Good Rod catches Dourado-Rei here. An Old Rod only catches Piabinha, but Piabinhas are people too.

O buritizal é casa de Antão e de abelha-.en: The buriti grove is home to Antão and queen bees. Tread softly… or fight fast!

O buritizal aplaude. Eu não..en: The buriti grove applauds. I don't.

Atrás do cipó tem um bosque escondido. O.en: Behind the vines there's a hidden grove. The Machete opens it, but close the door on your way out. Kidding: there's no door.

No cercado do Seu Nico quem manda sou eu.en: In Seu Nico's corral, the boss is me and my seriema. Yee-haw!

Para voltar mais rápido, pule as saliênc.en: To get back faster, hop down the corral ledges. To go forward, follow the gates.

Psiu! Uma Araracanga pousou no buriti. A.en: Shh! An Araracanga landed on the buriti. Now it's going to land on you!

Voou. Eu também queria voar daqui..en: It flew off. I wish I could fly off too.

A observadora do Cerrado Aberto está pro.en: The birdwatcher in Cerrado Aberto is looking for nests to photograph. Go talk to her, she loves a chat.

Roda de capoeira na beira da vereda! Ent.en: Capoeira roda by the vereda! Jump in, the berimbau won't wait!

Lá em Cidade Ginga tem um mestre de verd.en: In Cidade Ginga there's a real master. But first you've got a lot of chapada to climb.

Lição de escoteira número um: nunca sube.en: Scout lesson number one: never underestimate an Emaçu. Lesson number two: never underestimate me!

Lição número três: perder também ensina..en: Lesson number three: losing teaches too.

A estrada dá a volta no capinzal. Se voc.en: The road loops around the tall grass. If you get lost, follow the tallest termite mound. Or the shortest.

Ô treinador! No cerrado quem chocalha pr.en: Hey, trainer! In the cerrado, whoever rattles first wins. Did you hear my Cascavelão?

Chocalhou foi o meu joelho..en: The only thing rattling now is my knees.

A saída leste do cerrado desce para o Pa.en: The cerrado's east exit goes down to the Pantanal. From there, take the boardwalks to Pantanal Grande.

O Gaviãozão vê um rato a dois quilômetro.en: Gaviãozão can spot a rat two kilometers away. I can spot a challenger two meters away!

Vi tudo. Inclusive a minha derrota..en: I saw everything. Including my own defeat.

Os ninhos do cerrado ficam no alto dos i.en: Cerrado nests sit high up in the ipê trees. The birdwatcher photographs them but never touches. Do the same.

No cerrado aberto a roda é grande! Vem,.en: In the open cerrado the roda is huge! Come on, the rhea's already in!

Saí da roda pela porta dos fundos..en: I left the roda through the back door.

Treine Ginga contra Ginga e você aprende.en: Train Brawl against Brawl and you learn where it hurts. I just learned.

Pesquisa de campo: quanto tempo um Campe.en: Field research: how long can a League Champion last against a Cupinzeiro-Vivo? Starting the stopwatch!

Resultado: pouco. O meu cupinzeiro, quer.en: Result: not long. My termite mound, I mean.

O Quebra-pedra abre as rochas rachadas e.en: Rock Smash opens cracked rocks and old termite mounds. Inside are critters that have never seen the sun.

Ô menino da Costa, que veio de trem, / n.en: Hey, kid from the Coast, who came by the train, / no one crosses the cerrado, it's all in vain! / Only those who can sing and can battle remain!

Perdi a rima, perdi a batalha, / sobrou.en: Lost my rhyme, lost the fight, what a mess, / all I've got is my fiddle and a straw hat, I guess.

De noite o cerrado brilha de Vagalampo..en: At night the cerrado glows with Vagalampo. Whoever walks in the dark walks with music.

O Tuiuiú é a ave símbolo do Pantanal. E.en: The Tuiuiú is the Pantanal's symbol bird. And this battle is the symbol of my stubbornness!

O Tuiuiú voou para longe. Eu fiquei..en: The Tuiuiú flew far away. I stayed.

Ali na passarela tem um ninho no Morro d.en: Over by the boardwalk there's a nest on Morro do Urucum the birdwatcher will want in her photo.

Pesquei um Jaú-Gigante do tamanho da can.en: I caught a Jaú-Gigante as big as my canoe! Now I'm going to catch a win!

O peixe grande escapou. Como sempre..en: The big one got away. As always.

Na água funda do sul, com Vara Mestra, d.en: In the deep water to the south, with a Master Rod, they say Pirarucão bites. Never seen it. But I believe it.

Tocando boiada pelo alagado desde menino.en: I've been driving cattle through the floodplain since I was a boy. You're just one more steer in the way!

Pantanal Grande é logo ali, depois das p.en: Pantanal Grande is just past the stilt houses. Zefa never loses to anyone… almost.

Sou peão da Boiadeira Zefa! Antes de ent.en: I'm Cowgirl Zefa's ranch hand! Before you enter her gym, you go through me!

Passou. A Zefa vai gostar de você..en: You got through. Zefa's going to like you.

No ginásio o chão é de lama que afunda..en: In the gym the floor is sinking mud. Plan your path before taking the first step.

Aguapé flutua, Lavadeira-Dragão voa e vo.en: Water hyacinths float, Lavadeira-Dragão flies and you… you're going down!

Caí eu, na lagoa, de roupa e tudo..en: I went down, into the lagoon, clothes and all.

Leve criatura de Rio, Mata ou Geada para.en: Bring River, Grass or Frost creatures to Zefa. Earth critters sink in the water.

Ninhal fechado para reforma! Reforma do.en: Rookery closed for renovations! Rust Cartel renovations, of course.

Reformaram foi a minha cara..en: The only thing renovated was my face.

O tenente Arame está lá no meio, contand.en: Lieutenant Arame is in the middle, counting eggs. He miscounts on purpose so there are extras for him.

Ovo de tuiuiú vale ouro lá fora. E você.en: Tuiuiú eggs are worth gold abroad. And you're worth a kick in the pants!

Quem levou o pé fui eu..en: I'm the one who got kicked.

Os ovos estão no barco, prontos para des.en: The eggs are on the boat, ready to go downriver. If Arame falls, they go back to the nests.

Mais um passo e eu chamo o tenente! Aliá.en: One more step and I'm calling the lieutenant! Actually, he's already coming.

Pode ir. Eu não vi nada..en: Go on. I didn't see anything.

Ilhota do sudeste: meu pesqueiro secreto.en: The southeast islet: my secret fishing spot. If you found it, you'll have to fight!

Pode pescar aqui. Mas não conte para nin.en: You can fish here. Just don't tell anyone.

O Ariranhão anda em bando. Se aparecer u.en: Ariranhão travel in packs. If one shows up, four more are already watching.

Tenente Arame, do Cartel Ferrugem, às or.en: Lieutenant Arame, Rust Cartel, at Colonel Garrote's command. This rookery is our pen now, fenced in barbed wire! League Champion, huh? On the Coast you crushed Lata and bent Rebite. No such luck with me: wire bends, but it doesn't break!

Vergou… e quebrou. Arame velho é assim..en: It bent… and it broke. That's old wire for you.

No cais quem não pesca, luta. E eu faço.en: On the docks, whoever isn't fishing is fighting. And I do both!

Hoje não deu peixe nem vitória..en: No fish and no win today.

O Saveiro desce o rio até Cidade Coral..en: The Saveiro goes downriver to Cidade Coral. If you get seasick going, you get less seasick coming back.

Já surfei a pororoca! Uma batalhinha no.en: I've surfed the pororoca! A little battle on the docks is a ripple to me!

A Estrada Vermelha sobe para a Chapada R.en: The Estrada Vermelha climbs up to Chapada Rubra. Up there the only wave is a heat wave.

Tropa de mula parada na estrada? Não: tr.en: A mule train stuck on the road? No: a creature train ready for a brawl!

A tropa voltou para o pasto..en: The train went back to pasture.

Tem três rochas rachadas fechando a estr.en: Three cracked rocks are blocking the road. Rock Smash opens them and the path goes on.

Bateei a estrada inteira atrás de pepita.en: I panned the whole road looking for nuggets. Found you. You'll do!

Pepita sai de rocha rachada. O Seu Casca.en: Nuggets come from cracked rocks. Seu Cascalho, in Chapada Rubra, trades nuggets for scrolls.

Urubu-Rei voa em círculo em cima de quem.en: The Urubu-Rei circles above whoever's about to lose. Look up!

Ele estava em cima de mim o tempo todo..en: It was above me the whole time.

Na Mesa do Gavião tem um ninho que nenhu.en: On Mesa do Gavião there's a nest no camera can reach. Only climbers.

Na Estrada Vermelha, de terra e de sol,.en: On the Estrada Vermelha, all dust and all sun, / I sing and I battle, it's twice the fun! / Whoever loses gets my lighthouse, hon!

Ganhou o duelo, levou o farol… / brincad.en: You won the duel, took the light as your own… / kidding, the light belongs to the sun alone.

Viola e criatura: as duas pedem afinação.en: Fiddle and creature: both need tuning. And patience.

Treino para os paredões da chapada! Você.en: Training for the chapada cliffs! You're my warm-up!

Aqueceu demais. Queimei..en: Warmed up too much. I got burned.

Sem o Amuleto de Escalar ninguém sobe o.en: Without the Climb Charm no one gets up the Chapada Rubra cliff. Topázio is the one who gives it out.

Meu bicho dá o bote antes do berimbau te.en: My critter strikes before the berimbau finishes the song. Dodge!

Jararacuçu não avisa. Cascavelão avisa,.en: A Jararacuçu gives no warning. A Cascavelão does, but by then it's too late.

Última curva antes da Chapada Rubra! Daq.en: Last bend before Chapada Rubra! From here on, only the thick-shelled get through!

Casco duro e cabeça mole, o meu..en: Thick shell and soft head, that's me.

Dizem que o Cartel tomou a Mina Velha. O.en: They say the Cartel took over the Mina Velha. Topázio went down alone to get them out.

Ginásio fechado, mas eu estou aberto! Pa.en: The gym's closed, but I'm open! For battles, I mean.

O ginásio só abre quando o Topázio volta.en: The gym only opens when Topázio comes back from the mine. The mine entrance is to the east, past the bonfire.

Daqui eu vejo o paredão inteiro. Daqui e.en: From here I can see the whole cliff. And from here I can also see your defeat!

Bicho de Pedra apanha de Rio, Mata, Ging.en: Stone critters get beaten by River, Grass, Brawl, Earth and Iron. Build your team with that in mind.

Mina interditada pelo Cartel Ferrugem! V.en: Mine closed by the Rust Cartel! Back to the surface!

Volto eu..en: I'll be the one going back.

As gaiolas estão lá embaixo. A escada fi.en: The cages are down below. The ladder is in the northeast corner. Oops.

Galeria de cima é minha! A de baixo é do.en: The upper gallery is mine! The lower one is the lieutenant's!

A de cima também não é mais minha..en: The upper one isn't mine anymore either.

O tenente Rebite voltou da Costa jurando.en: Lieutenant Rebite came back from the Coast swearing revenge. He hates Champions. And ladders.

O Cartel me prendeu aqui para cavar túne.en: The Cartel locked me in here to dig tunnels. At least an honest battle, for a change!

Lá embaixo o Topázio está amarrado, mas.en: Down below, Topázio is tied up, but he won't stop giving advice. Stubborn as they come.

Ninguém passa da galeria funda! Ordens d.en: Nobody gets past the deep gallery! Lieutenant Rebite's orders!

Esses bichos todos vão para fora do país.en: All these critters are going out of the country. You're going out of the mine!

Saio eu. De ré..en: I'm the one going out. Backwards.

Na planilha do tenente tem até o nome do.en: The lieutenant's spreadsheet even has the buyer's name. He's disorganized.

Último capanga antes do tenente! Último.en: Last goon before the lieutenant! Last obstacle! Last…

VOCÊ! O moleque do Farol! Perdi a lanter.en: YOU! The kid from the Lighthouse! I lost the lantern, lost the lighthouse, lost my fake lightkeeper job… But down here, in my mine, I'll bolt you to the rock! A Rebite never comes loose!

Soltou… Rebite espanado não segura nem q.en: Came loose… A stripped rivet can't even hold up a picture.

Primeiro degrau! Quem não aguenta o prim.en: First step! If you can't handle the first step, you won't climb the fifth!

Desci um degrau na vida..en: I went down a step in life.

Cada paredão tem um pé de trepadeira. A.en: Every cliff has creepers at the bottom. The ledge at the edge is for coming down fast.

As Araracangas fazem ninho nos paredões..en: Araracangas nest on the cliffs. And they zap anyone who gets close!

Do alto da chapada dá para ver Arraial B.en: From the top of the chapada you can see Arraial Brasa. The forge smoke rises straight up when there's no wind.

Capoeira em cima de paredão: um passo er.en: Capoeira on a cliff: one wrong step and the roda ends at the bottom!

Terminei lá embaixo. Figurativamente..en: I ended at the bottom. Figuratively.

O Prego-Mestre bate com martelo de pedra.en: Prego-Mestre hits with a stone hammer. Charm and Wind critters take it better.

Ali embaixo tem uma rocha rachada que es.en: Down there a cracked rock hides a cave. But the cave is mine, and you're not getting through!

Passou. A gruta é sua..en: You got through. The cave is yours.

Lá em cima, atrás de um pedregulho, tem.en: Up top, behind a boulder, there's a nook. With Strength you can push it.

Subi a chapada cantando aboio, / desci a.en: I climbed the chapada singing my cattle call, / came down the chapada with no help at all! / Now watch my caravan, it's ready to brawl!

O comboio parou na porteira… / perdi a r.en: The caravan stopped at the gate, what a shame… / lost my rhyme and I lost the whole game.

O Urubu-Rei só aparece quando ninguém es.en: The Urubu-Rei only shows up when no one's looking. Ever thought about that?

Casco de pedra e couraça de ferro: a min.en: Stone shells and iron armor: my team doesn't scratch!

A Caverna Vulcânica é escura de verdade..en: The Caverna Vulcânica is truly dark. Without the Lantern you can't even see your own feet.

Último degrau antes do Arraial! Daqui pa.en: Last step before the Arraial! From here up, only those with cattle-drive stamina get through!

Fôlego de boiada você tem. Eu tenho fôle.en: You've got cattle-drive stamina. I've got calf stamina.

No Arraial Brasa a Ferreira Labareda ace.en: In Arraial Brasa, Smith Labareda lights bonfires in the order of a song. Listen to the accordion.

Pedra de vulcão é a mais bonita: preta e.en: Volcanic rock is the prettiest: black and shiny. Just like my strategy!

O chão esquenta para o norte. No fundo,.en: The ground gets hotter to the north. Deep down, they say, lives whoever heats the ground.

Mergulho em caverna é comigo! Aqui não t.en: Cave diving is my thing! There's no water here, but there's a battle!

O Noitão enxerga no escuro. Eu só enxerg.en: Noitão can see in the dark. I can only see with the Lantern, same as you.

Medindo a caverna há um mês. Agora vou m.en: I've been measuring this cave for a month. Now I'll measure your strength!

Os poços de lava estão cercados de pedra.en: The lava pools are fenced with stone. Thank goodness. I've already lost two boots.

Vim buscar brasa de vulcão para a forja.en: I came for volcano embers for the Arraial Brasa forge. Embers from here never go out!

A Labareda diz que o Boitatá é o padrinh.en: Labareda says Boitatá is the godfather of the Arraial forges. She says it with a straight face.

Aprendiz da Ferreira Labareda! Primeiro.en: Smith Labareda's apprentice! First you get past my hammer!

O martelo entortou. Eu também..en: The hammer got bent. So did I.

A Labareda acende as fogueiras do ginási.en: Labareda lights the gym's bonfires in the order of a song. Listen to the accordion before you go lighting things.

Toca a sanfona, que a quadrilha já vai c.en: Play the accordion, the square dance is on its way! / Whoever joins the circle has to dance and play!

Dançou, ganhou e ainda bateu palma… / a.en: You danced, you won, and you clapped along too… / the square dance is yours, I've lost my cool.

Sábado tem São João no terreiro. A Dona.en: On Saturday there's São João in the yard. Dona Quentão always needs help with the bonfires.

{JOGADOR}! Eu peguei o trem uma semana d.en: {JOGADOR}! I took the train a week after you and I've already beaten Cowgirl Zefa! You've got two Sertão badges and I've got one? Then we're almost tied. Almost isn't tied. Full team, now!

De novo… Mas viu como a minha equipe cre.en: Again… But did you see how my team has grown? I saw yours grow too. The good kind of mad.

Maré.ctx: src/data/treinadores/b2-sul.ts:43 · t() | src/data/treinadores/b2-sul.ts:45 · t() | src/data/treinadores/liga.ts:53 · mestre()

Dezesseis insígnias… Então é você que fe.en: Sixteen badges… So you're the one who shuts down my power plants, frees my nests and blows up my labs. Know what's inside that Hall? Five old-timers and the biggest collection of rare creatures in Pingorama. I came to take it. And you came to get in my way for the last time!

Impossível… Uma criança e um punhado de.en: Impossible… A child and a handful of backwoods critters. The Rust Cartel… ends here. But remember: as long as there are people who want cages, there'll be people who want to sell them.

{JOGADOR}! Eu vi o Garrote descendo a tr.en: {JOGADOR}! I saw Garrote heading down the trail in handcuffs with the Guardians. You did that, right? Of course you did. Before you go in there, one last time: you and me, full teams, like that first morning in Prof. Ipê's lab. No being-tired excuses!

Pronto. Agora eu sei: você não é o meu r.en: There. Now I know: you're not my rival. You're my yardstick. Go in there and show them what the Coast and the Sertão raised.

Eu sou Iara Costa, Guardiã do Mar. Guard.en: I am Iara Costa, Sea Guardian. I guard the rivers that run down the mountains and the sea that receives them. Water is never in a hurry, {JOGADOR}: it goes around, it waits and, when the flood comes, it carries everything away. Let's see if you can swim.

A maré virou, e virou bonita. Siga: o Ca.en: The tide turned, and turned beautifully. Go on: Cauã has already heard your footsteps in the forest.

Cauã, Guardião da Mata. Cada árvore dest.en: Cauã, Forest Guardian. Every tree on these mountains knows me by name. In the forest nobody fights alone: the ant, the tapir and the tortoise work together. Show me your team is a forest too!

A mata abriu caminho para você. Isso ela.en: The forest made way for you. It doesn't do that for just anyone. Jandaia awaits in the sky.

Jandaia, Guardiã do Céu! Daqui de cima e.en: Jandaia, Sky Guardian! From up here I watch the clouds being born. Two wins and you're still standing? Then hold on to your hat, because up here it blows, it thunders and lightning strikes!

Que tempestade foi essa? Foi a sua. Pass.en: What storm was that? It was yours. Go on: Moacir is patient as stone, but he doesn't like to wait.

Moacir. Guardião da Terra. Sou o chão on.en: Moacir. Earth Guardian. I am the ground you've walked on since you left home. One… two… three… I count slowly because stone is never in a hurry. Let's see how long you last under the mountain.

A montanha tremeu. Faz tempo que isso nã.en: The mountain shook. It's been a long time since that happened. Go, the High Guardian has known your name since you were born.

Arandu quer dizer \"o que guarda a memór.en: Arandu means "the one who keeps memory". I keep all of Pingorama's: Iara's sea, Cauã's forest, Jandaia's sky, Moacir's earth. You came from Vila Jacarandá to the top of the world, {JOGADOR}. Now show me what you learned along the way — with everything you've got.

Eis a memória nova de Pingorama. Você e.en: Behold Pingorama's newest memory. You and your creatures fight like those who care. That's what the Council was waiting for.

Guardiã da Prova.ctx: src/data/treinadores/ginasio-16.ts:9 · campo classe | src/data/treinadores/ginasio-16.ts:15 · campo classe | src/data/treinadores/ginasio-16.ts:21 · campo classe

Cheguei ao terceiro Mestre mês passado..en: I made it to the third Master last month. I'm working up the courage to go back. Help me warm up?

Esquentei até demais..en: I warmed up a little too much.

A Mestra Maré envenena primeiro e alaga.en: Master Maré poisons first and floods after. Bring Pure Honey and someone Earth or Mind: Thunder alone won't handle hers.

Treino aqui para o Brasa-Viva. Ferro com.en: I train here for Brasa-Viva. Iron on iron: hit me, I want to hear the clang!

O Brasa-Viva tem Brasa e tem Ferro. Terr.en: Brasa-Viva has Ember and Iron. Earth hits both; River puts out half. Just don't send Grass or Bug into the forge.

Um verso antes da luta: quem entra na ne.en: A verse before the fight: who walks into the fog / not knowing whence they came / leaves telling their own tale / only halfway, all the same!

Perdi o fio do verso..en: I lost the thread of my verse.

O Pajé Neblina faz dormir e confunde. Po.en: Shaman Neblina puts you to sleep and confuses you. Copaiba Balm cures everything at once, and Spook moves hit his squarely.

Eita! Campeão de oito insígnias no meu t.en: Whoa! An eight-badge Champion in my yard? Then hold on for a warm-up rodeo!

A Pampa bate de perto e bate forte. Vent.en: Pampa hits up close and hits hard. Wind, Mind and Charm take down her Brawl; Spook doesn't even feel Normal moves.

Vim de Vila Buriti atrás de você. A Dona.en: I came from Vila Buriti after you. Dona Buriti says to tell you strong roots prove themselves in a drought!

Secou. A raiz era a sua..en: Dried up. The strong root was yours.

São cinco lutas sem Posto. Chá de Guaran.en: That's five battles with no Post. Guaraná Tea gets the fallen back up; Elixir refills health in one go. Spend your money at the Shop BEFORE going in.

Perdi para o Cacique três vezes. Aprendi.en: I lost to the Chief three times. I learned his moves by heart. Want to see? Then fight!

O Cacique abre com o Gaviãozão, paralisa.en: The Chief opens with Gaviãozão, paralyzes with Poraquê and saves Pirarucão for last. Charm and Frost get Legend good.

Sou a Maré, primeira Mestra. No mangue a.en: I'm Maré, the first Master. In the mangrove the water rises slowly, and by the time you notice it's up to your neck. That's my team: poison first, flood after!

A maré virou… e virou para o seu lado. P.en: The tide turned… and it turned your way. Go on, challenger: Brasa-Viva's forge is already lit.

Brasa-Viva, segundo Mestre! Sino bom se.en: Brasa-Viva, second Master! A good bell is made by hammering: iron in the coals, hammer on the iron. Let's see what alloy your team is made of!

Rachou o meu sino… e que som bonito ele.en: You cracked my bell… and what a lovely sound it made. Go, the Shaman's fog is waiting for you.

Sente, desafiante. Eu sou o Neblina, e t.en: Sit down, challenger. I'm Neblina, and every battle of mine starts with a story: once upon a time a team walked into this room… and couldn't remember how it left.

Essa história eu não conhecia: a do desa.en: That's a story I didn't know: the one about the challenger who crossed the fog. I'll tell it to my grandchildren. Pampa is the next gate.

Eita, chegou longe! Sou a Pampa, última.en: Whoa, you got far! I'm Pampa, the last gate before the Champion. My critters aren't tamed by shouting: they're tamed by rhythm. Hold on tight, the rodeo's about to start!

Me derrubou da sela, e com classe! Atrás.en: You knocked me out of the saddle, and with style! Behind that door is Chief Aracê. Take off your hat when you go in.

Aracê quer dizer \"o nascer do dia\". Há.en: Aracê means "the break of day". For twenty years I've watched the sun rise from this Platô, and for twenty years nobody has moved me from here. You brought eight badges and beat four Masters. One dawn to go. Show me your whole team, {JOGADOR}!

O sol… nasceu do outro lado hoje. Vinte.en: The sun… rose on the other side today. Twenty years! And I lost smiling. You and your creatures fight like you're having a conversation.

CAMPEÃO?! Você?! Eu estava presa no terc.en: CHAMPION?! You?! I was stuck at the third Master and heard the Platô bell ring for YOU! No, no, no. Before any party, {JOGADOR}: you and me, here, now. Full team!

Tá. Tá bom! Você é o Campeão e eu sou… a.en: Fine. Fine! You're the Champion and I'm… next. Write it down: NEXT.
