Perdi para o Pajé Neblina. As criaturas.en: I lost to Shaman Neblina. His creatures put you to sleep and then haunt your dreams.

Leve criatura do tipo Assombro ou de Men.en: Bring a Spook-type creature or a strong Mind one. And Copaiba Balm. Lots of it.

Salve o jogo antes de entrar, descanse a.en: Save before you go in, rest your team and check your bag.

Parece conselho de mãe. É que a minha mã.en: Sounds like a mom's advice. That's because my mom was a League Master.

Última venda antes da glória! Ou da verg.en: Last shop before glory! Or shame. Either way, take some Elixir.

São cinco lutas sem descanso: os golpes.en: That's five battles with no rest: the good moves run out before the creatures do. Cane Juice restores one spent move.

Custa os olhos da cara. Mas contra o Cam.en: It costs an arm and a leg. But against the Champion, an arm and a leg is pocket change.

PLATÔ DA LIGA DOS GUARDIÕES\nQuatro Mest.en:
LEAGUE OF GUARDIANS PLATÔ
Four Masters and a Champion. Eight badges to get in; courage to stay.

POSTO GUARDIÃO DO PLATÔ\nCure-se AQUI. L.en:
PLATÔ GUARDIAN POST
Heal up HERE. Inside, only what fits in your bag.

VENDA DO PLATÔ\nPreço de altitude. Recla.en:
PLATÔ SHOP
High-altitude prices. Complaints: go down the mountain.

REGRAS DA LIGA\n1. Entrou, não volta. 2.en:
LEAGUE RULES
1. Once in, no going back.  2. Five battles in a row.  3. Healing by items only.
4. Lose, and start over from the first Master.  5. No crying on the carpet.

Estátua de um Campeão antigo. A placa di.en: Statue of a Champion of old. The plaque just says: "Made it here. So can you."

O Marco do Hall da Fama. Os nomes dos Ca.en: The Hall of Fame Marker. The names of the Champions of Costa do Sol are carved from top to bottom.

Alto! Sou o Guardião da Entrada. Daqui p.en: Halt! I'm the Guardian of the Entrance. From here up is the League Platô. Show me your case… You're missing badges. It's EIGHT, buddy: one from each gym in Costa do Sol. Come back when your case is full.

A porta da sala de espera trancou atrás.en: The waiting room door locked behind you. In the League you only move forward.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Mestr.en: The door only opens for those who beat Master Maré.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Ferre.en: The door only opens for those who beat Smith Brasa-Viva.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Pajé.en: The door only opens for those who beat Shaman Neblina.

A porta do Hall da Fama só se abre pelas.en: The Hall of Fame door only opens by the Champion's hand.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Domad.en: The door only opens for those who beat Tamer Pampa. On the other side waits the Champion.

Maré mistura Rio com Veneno; Brasa-Viva,.en: Maré mixes River with Poison; Brasa-Viva, Ember with Iron; Neblina, Mind with Spook; Pampa, Normal with Brawl.

O Cacique Aracê usa de tudo um pouco, e.en: Chief Aracê uses a bit of everything, and saves a Legend-type creature for last. Charm and Frost scare Legend.

Eu venho todo dia ver quem entra. Sair p.en: I come every day to see who goes in. I've seen few come out the front door.

Você tem cara de quem sai. Ou de quem vo.en: You look like someone who'll come out. Or come back fast. One of the two.

CERRADO ABERTO\nA estrada dá a volta no.en:
CERRADO ABERTO
The road loops around the tall grass and comes back here. You can't get lost. (People have.)

MESA DE PEDRA\nSubida só para quem tem o.en:
STONE MESA
Climb only with the Climb Charm.

CLAREIRA DA DONA RAIZEIRA\nO cipó cresce.en:
DONA RAIZEIRA'S CLEARING
The vines grew back. Bring a machete and goodwill.

GROTÃO DO PEDREGULHO\nA pedra rolou na ú.en:
BOULDER HOLLOW
The rock rolled down in the last rain. Push it with Strength (and finesse).

LAGOA DO CERRADO\nBebedouro das emas. Fa.en:
CERRADO LAGOON
The rheas' watering hole. Please don't compete with them.

Um totem antigo, com um tamanduá entalha.en: An ancient totem with a carved anteater. Someone left ipê flowers at its base.

O Emaçu corre mais que o trem!.en: Emaçu runs faster than the train!

Eu apostei corrida com um. Ele nem perce.en: I raced one once. It didn't even notice it was a race. To the east is the way down to the Pantanal.

Tá vendo essas rochas rachadas e os cupi.en: See these cracked rocks and old termite mounds? There are critters living inside.

Com o Amuleto Quebra-pedra da Dona Benta.en: With Dona Benta Sombra's Rock Smash Charm you can open them. Inside live Cupinzeiro-Vivo, Saúva-Rainha and, if you're lucky, a Minhocão.

De noite o cerrado acende: Vagalampo, Gr.en: At night the cerrado lights up: Vagalampo, Grilão-Elétrico, Bruxaluz…

E o Urutau-Fantasma finge que é galho. S.en: And the Urutau-Fantasma pretends to be a branch. Shake the thick-trunked trees after sunset.

Naquela ilhota tem coisa brilhando. Bril.en: Something's been shining on that islet. It's shone since I was a girl.

Nunca fui ver. Cada um tem o mistério qu.en: I never went to look. Everyone gets the mystery they deserve.

(O Emaçu encara você, pisca devagar e vo.en: (The Emaçu stares at you, blinks slowly and goes back to pecking at the grass.)

CHAPADA DOS PAREDÕES\nCinco degraus de p.en:
CHAPADA DOS PAREDÕES
Five stone steps up to Arraial Brasa. Go up by the creepers; come down by the ledges.

CAVERNA VULCÂNICA\nEscuridão total. Chão.en:
CAVERNA VULCÂNICA
Total darkness. Hot ground. Without a Lantern, don't even think about it.
"Here sleeps the fire serpent." — the ancients

ARRAIAL BRASA logo ao norte.\nForjas, fo.en:
ARRAIAL BRASA just to the north.
Forges, the São João bonfire and Smith Labareda's Gym.

Cada paredão tem um pé de trepadeira. Su.en: Every cliff has creepers at its foot. Climb up those. To get down, hop off the ledge at the edge: it's faster and more fun.

A cascata do oeste? Aquilo só se sobe co.en: The west waterfall? That one only goes up with Master Gingado's Waterfall Charm. I tried with a rope. The rope came down first.

Medi o chão da Caverna Vulcânica: quaren.en: I measured the Caverna Vulcânica floor: forty degrees. And rising whenever something big passes through in there.

Os antigos chamam de Boitatá. Ele só aco.en: The ancients call it Boitatá. It only wakes for those who carry the Crystal Badge. Good thing I only brought a thermometer.

CAVERNA VULCÂNICA\nO chão esquenta a cad.en:
CAVERNA VULCÂNICA
The ground gets hotter with every step north. Deep down, the heat breathes.

PANTANAL ALAGADO\nOeste: Cerrado Aberto..en:
PANTANAL ALAGADO
West: Cerrado Aberto. East, via the boardwalks: Pantanal Grande.
South: the rookery (closed off by Cowgirl Zefa).

PASSARELA DO URUCUM\nTábua velha, rio fu.en:
URUCUM BOARDWALK
Old planks, deep river, curious caiman. Walk in the middle.

PANTANAL GRANDE logo a leste.\nPalafitas.en:
PANTANAL GRANDE just to the east.
Stilt houses, cattle and Cowgirl Zefa's Gym.

NINHAL DO PANTANAL\nTuiuiús, garças e co.en:
PANTANAL ROOKERY
Tuiuiús, egrets and spoonbills nest here in the flood season. Do not touch the eggs.

Um peão da Boiadeira Zefa atravessa a ca.en:
One of Cowgirl Zefa's ranch hands blocks the channel with his canoe:
"Hey, Champ! The rookery's closed: there are folks prowling around the eggs and Zefa had it shut." "Her orders: only those with the Clay Badge get through. Rookery critters are big and wild, no place for someone who hasn't beaten the cowgirl yet."

Uma rede de arrasto do Cartel Ferrugem f.en:
A Rust Cartel dragnet closes the channel from bank to bank, tied to iron stakes.
No canoe, no fish, not even a guess gets through.

Lá em cima do Morro do Urucum tem um nin.en: Up on top of Morro do Urucum there's an old Tuiuiú nest and some shiny stones.

Morro de pedra lisa, com trepadeira na f.en: A smooth stone hill, with creepers on the south face. Only those with the Climb Charm can go up.

Contei os ninhos do ninhal: todos os ovo.en: I counted the rookery nests: all the eggs are back and hatching!

Os filhotes que o Cartel tirou dos ninho.en: The chicks the Cartel took from the nests are at the Pantanal Grande Rehab Center. The vet is looking for people to adopt them.

A Zefa mandou agradecer: a rede do Carte.en: Zefa sends her thanks: the Cartel's net is out of the south channel. Porto Pantaneiro is open again.

De lá sai a Estrada Vermelha, que sobe p.en: From there the Estrada Vermelha climbs up to Chapada Rubra. Bring Rock Smash: the road is nothing but cracked rocks.

VEREDA DOS BURITIS\nNorte: Cerrado Abert.en:
VEREDA DOS BURITIS
North: Cerrado Aberto. South: Vila Cascavel.
Where there are buritis, there's water. Where there's water, there are critters.

LAGOA DO CHAPÉU PERDIDO\nA ilhota só se.en:
LOST HAT LAGOON
The islet can only be reached by canoe.

CERCADO DO SEU NICO\nNa ida, siga as por.en:
SEU NICO'S CORRAL
Going: follow the gates. Coming back: hop the ledges.

Rocha rachada. Dá para ouvir o vento pas.en: A cracked rock. You can hear the wind whistling through the cracks.

CERRADO ABERTO logo ao norte.\nCuidado c.en:
CERRADO ABERTO just to the north.
Watch out for the termite mounds: some of them walk.

Vento levou o chapéu de um moço de Vila.en: The wind blew a Vila Cascavel guy's hat onto that islet.

Eu ia buscar, mas minha canoa só anda co.en: I'd go get it, but my canoe only moves with a River creature pulling it. And mine took the day off.

Fiz o cercado em zigue-zague para as ema.en: I built the corral in a zigzag so the rheas wouldn't escape.

As emas pulam por cima. Quem fica dando.en: The rheas just jump over it. I'm the one going around in circles.

Plantei pitanga nos canteiros. Se você p.en: I planted pitanga in the beds. If you plant a fruit, it grows with the clock.

Tem que regar? Tem. Eu rego? Às vezes..en: Does it need watering? It does. Do I water it? Sometimes.

De noite o Graxaim-da-Névoa sai para caç.en: At night the Graxaim-da-Névoa comes out to hunt around here, and the Tucanuçus go to sleep.

Já a Pintada… essa aparece quando quer..en: Now the Pintada… that one shows up when it feels like it. I saw one once. I cried with joy and it left without looking back.

As árvores de tronco grosso escondem Jat.en: The thick-trunked trees hide Jataí-Rainha. Just give them a shake.

Sacudi uma e caiu uma manga na minha cab.en: I shook one and a mango fell on my head. That counts too.

ESTRADA VERMELHA\nOeste: Porto Pantaneir.en:
ESTRADA VERMELHA
West: Porto Pantaneiro. East: Chapada Rubra.
The red dirt stains your boots. The boots will get used to it.

CHAPADA RUBRA logo adiante.\nCidade do g.en:
CHAPADA RUBRA just ahead.
Town of prospectors, the old mine and the Stone Gym.

MESA DO GAVIÃO\nNinho de Gaviãozão no al.en:
MESA DO GAVIÃO
Gaviãozão nest up top. Climbing only with the Climb Charm.

Pedra rachada fecha a estrada em três lu.en: Cracked rocks block the road in three places. Whoever passes with Rock Smash leaves them open, but on the way back the rock grows again.

Pedra que cresce? É o Minhocão por baixo.en: Rocks that grow? It's the Minhocão underneath, pushing. Or it's a drover's tale. Your pick.

Lá no fundo, aquele poço seco tem uma ca.en: Way back, that dry well has a waterfall that only flows upward on a full moon. Fibbing: it flows down, like every waterfall.

Para subir aquilo você precisa do Amulet.en: To climb that you need the Waterfall Charm. To have patience, you need chamomile tea.

TRILHA DA RODA\nOeste: Arraial Brasa · L.en:
TRILHA DA RODA
West: Arraial Brasa · East: Cidade Ginga.
Whoever passes without a ginga pays a forfeit!

CIDADE GINGA logo adiante.\n\"Aqui o chã.en:
CIDADE GINGA just ahead.
"Here the ground is a drum and your feet are the sticks."

O TABULEIRO\nSubida só para quem sabe Es.en:
THE TABLELAND
Climb only if you know how to Climb.
Up top the wind blows poetry.

RIACHO DO ATABAQUE\nA Lagoa de Cima fica.en:
RIACHO DO ATABAQUE
Lagoa de Cima is past the waterfall.
They say only Master Gingado's berimbau teaches you to go up.

Vim do Arraial com a tropa de mulas, mas.en: I came from the Arraial with my mule train, but they balked when they heard the berimbau.

Mula com suingue. Só nesta trilha mesmo..en: Mules with swing. Only on this trail.

Dica de tropeiro: sacuda as árvores de t.en: Drover's tip: shake the thick-trunked trees. Herculão loves to nap up there.

Tá vendo aquela cascata? Lá em cima tem.en: See that waterfall? Up top there's a lagoon with an islet.

Meu finado subia aquilo no braço. Hoje e.en: My late husband climbed that with his bare arms. Nowadays young folks need the Waterfall Charm.

O Mestre Gingado dá um para quem ganha d.en: Master Gingado gives one to whoever beats him. That's all. Easy, right?

♪ Quem tem pressa come cru,\nquem tem Cu.en:
♪ The hasty eat it raw,
with a Gourd you eat it roasted… ♪

Não faz sentido? Rima também cansa, cria.en: Doesn't make sense? Rhyming gets tiring too, friend.

À noite a trilha muda de gente: some o P.en: At night the trail changes crowds: the Papagaiozim vanish and Quatizão show up rummaging through the campfire.

Potes de doce em fila: buriti, mangaba,.en: Jars of preserves in a row: buriti, mangaba, cagaita, pequi. Each with a handwritten label and a little heart drawn on it.

Um baú de receitas. A de cima diz: \"Doc.en: A chest of recipes. The top one says: "Buriti preserves: patience, sugar and more patience."

O tacho de cobre borbulha no fogão a len.en: The copper pot bubbles on the wood stove. The smell of buriti fills the whole house.

A vó diz que doce de buriti cura tristez.en: Grandma says buriti preserves cure sadness.

Eu fico triste três vezes por dia, só po.en: I get sad three times a day, just to be safe.

Uma viola de dez cordas pendurada e um c.en: A ten-string viola hanging up and a songbook. The last page has only a title: "Missing Porto Pantaneiro".

Cordas de viola, palhetas de chifre e um.en: Viola strings, horn picks and a portrait of a girl by the river, with an inscription smudged from so much rereading.

A rede listrada balança sozinha. O viole.en: The striped hammock sways by itself. The fiddler swears it's the wind. There's no open window.

(O Bem-te-viço do violeiro canta três no.en: (The fiddler's Bem-te-viço sings three notes and waits for you to finish the tune.)

Cadernos de criação: \"Quero-Guarda: com.en: Breeding notebooks: "Quero-Guarda: eats everything, keeps everything, complains about everything." Next to them, show ribbons.

Coleiras de couro com plaquinha de nome,.en: Leather collars with little name tags, a fur brush and a whistle that makes no sound at all.

Um oratório com vela acesa e uma pena de.en: A home altar with a lit candle and a seriema feather tucked into the frame.

Meu marido é primo do Seu Aroeira, lá da.en: My husband is Seu Aroeira's cousin, from the Coast. In the family everybody raises critters and nobody raises any sense.

Ele vive trocando criatura com viajante..en: He's always trading creatures with travelers. Says a critter that travels learns more.

BILHETERIA DE VILA CASCAVEL\nO Passe do.en:
VILA CASCAVEL TICKET OFFICE
The Champions' Train Pass is good forever. The ticket clerk's patience is not.

LINHA SERRA-SOL\nPorto Sereia (Costa do.en:
SERRA-SOL LINE
Porto Sereia (Costa do Sol) – Vila Cascavel (Sertão das Névoas).
Mind the gap between the train and the mountain.

O maquinista confere a mochila e coça a.en:
The engineer checks your bag and scratches his head:
"Without the Train Pass I'm not going down the mountain, Champion. Chief Aracê gives one to whoever beats the League."

Quer voltar para Porto Sereia? É só subi.en: Want to go back to Porto Sereia? Just hop on the car. The steam train goes down the mountain in twenty minutes and up in forty: uphill is uphill.

Linha da serra só leva Campeão da Liga..en: The mountain line only takes League Champions. You're a Champion. Therefore, hop on whenever you like. Engineer logic.

Vim da Costa do Sol só para comer doce d.en: I came all the way from Costa do Sol just to eat buriti preserves in Vila Cascavel.

Já estou na terceira viagem. É um doce m.en: This is already my third trip. They're really good preserves. Or I'm really weak for sweets.

Tem gente de macacão cor de ferrugem ron.en: There are people in rust-colored overalls prowling the Pantanal. They loaded some cages onto the last freight train.

Não gostei da cara deles. Também não gos.en: I didn't like the look of them. Didn't like the look of the cages either. A cage shouldn't have a look at all.

Mapa do Sertão das Névoas com alfinetes:.en: A map of the Sertão das Névoas with pins: red in Pantanal Alagado, black in Chapada Rubra, and a yellow one marked "BOITATÁ?" in Caverna Vulcânica.

Réguas de cheia, cadernos encharcados e.en: Flood gauges, soaked notebooks and a rubber duck labeled "official buoy".

Um microscópio aponta para uma asa de La.en: A microscope points at a Lavadeira-Dragão wing. It looks like a church window.

Pastas: \"Ninhal do Pantanal — contagem.en: Folders: "Pantanal Rookery — egg count", "Rust Cartel — complaints", "Pequi recipes (not scientific)".

Um tanque de observação com um Aruazão d.en: An observation tank with an Aruazão asleep. Or meditating. With snails, you can't tell.

A Drª Buriti montou esta estação antes d.en: Dr. Buriti set up this station before moving to Vila Buriti, in Costa do Sol. She calls every Sunday over Rádio Cipó.

No Sertão, as criaturas já nascem para o.en: In the Sertão, creatures are born ready for Champion level. Anyone arriving from the League with a level-45 team feels the jolt for the first few days, but the Vereda and the Cerrado train you fast: by the Pantanal you'll be up to speed.

As cheias do Pantanal deixam os ninhos d.en: The Pantanal floods leave the rookery nests exposed. And the Rust Cartel knows it.

A Boiadeira Zefa interditou o ninhal. El.en: Cowgirl Zefa closed off the rookery. She only lets through those who prove they can handle big critters: whoever has the Clay Badge.

Descobri que o Sapo-Cururuí canta em dó.en: I found out the Sapo-Cururuí sings in C major.

Descobri também que ele canta às três da.en: I also found out it sings at three in the morning. Right next to my hammock.

• O violeiro da casa de madeira procura.en: • The fiddler in the wooden house is looking for a trustworthy courier for a letter. (Vila Cascavel)

• A observadora do Cerrado Aberto quer f.en: • The birdwatcher in Cerrado Aberto wants photos of five Sertão nests. (Cerrado Aberto)

• A Dona Mangaba troca receita por ingre.en: • Dona Mangaba trades recipes for ingredients. Ask at the pink house. (Vila Cascavel)

Vim tocando boi lá de Pantanal Grande. D.en: I drove cattle all the way from Pantanal Grande. By canoe, if you can believe it. The cattle swam and complained.

A Boiadeira Zefa só usa bicho de Terra..en: Cowgirl Zefa only uses Earth critters. Bring River, Grass or Frost, since clay plus water makes mud, and Zefa can't hold mud.

Os bichos do Sertão já chegam crescidos:.en: Sertão critters arrive full-grown: level 44, 45, almost League-sized!

Treine na Vereda antes de encarar a Zefa.en: Train in the Vereda before facing Zefa. And buy Root Tonic: in the Pantanal the nearest Post is on stilts.

Ex-votos de madeira: uma pata de Tatuzim.en: Wooden ex-votos: a Tatuzim paw, an Ararinha wing, a Jabutim shell. All healed here.

Uma chaleira de barro ferve chá de jurub.en: A clay kettle boils jurubeba tea. Bitter as can be, healing as can be.

O oratório da raizeira: uma vela, um gal.en: The herbalist's altar: a candle, a sprig of rue and an old photo of the gym, with the plaque "Leaf Badge".

Vidros de raízes secas com rótulos: \"Su.en: Jars of dried roots with labels: "Sucupira — achy joints", "Barbatimão — nasty cuts", "Purple ipê — creature blues".

A bancada de ervas. Tem pilão, peneira e.en: The herb bench. It has a mortar, a sieve and a notebook open to the page "what NOT to give Calangão".

Isto aqui já foi ginásio. A líder, a Don.en: This used to be a gym. The leader, Dona Buriti, learned herbs from Dona Sucupira and went off to open a gym in Costa do Sol.

Quando ela saiu, deixou o salão para a m.en: When she left, she handed the hall to her teacher. Now the only battle in here is against tummy aches.

Trouxe meu Antão para tomar chá de casca.en: I brought my Antão for some bark tea. He stepped on a termite mound and the termite mound stepped back.

A Dona Sucupira não cobra nada. Diz que.en: Dona Sucupira doesn't charge a thing. She says healing plants have no owner.

Venda do Pequi, às ordens! Cuia de palha.en: Pequi Shop, at your service! Buriti-straw gourds, root tea and andiroba repellent. The rest is chit-chat, and chit-chat is free.

Cuia de Rede é a melhor para o Pantanal:.en: Net Gourds are the best for the Pantanal: River critters slip out of a regular gourd like soap.

E a Cuia Noturna para o cerrado de noite.en: And Night Gourds for the cerrado at night, since the critters there only come out after sunset.

VILA CASCAVEL\nOnde o Trem Serra-Sol des.en:
VILA CASCAVEL
Where the Serra-Sol Train comes down the mountain and the Sertão begins.
North: Vereda dos Buritis. East, across the lagoon: Pantanal Alagado.

ESTAÇÃO DE VILA CASCAVEL\nLinha Serra-So.en:
VILA CASCAVEL STATION
Serra-Sol Line: Porto Sereia – Vila Cascavel. Hold on to your hat in the tunnel.

SALÃO DA RAIZEIRA\nAqui já foi ginásio..en:
HERBALIST'S HALL
This used to be a gym. Now it's tea, advice and root cures.
"Healing plants are never in a hurry."

LAGOA DO CASCAVEL\nCanoa só com o Amulet.en:
LAGOA DO CASCAVEL
Canoe only with the Paddle Charm and a River creature pulling.
Pantanal Alagado begins where the lagoon ends, to the east.

MIRANTE DO PEQUIZEIRO\nDaqui se vê a Cha.en:
PEQUI TREE LOOKOUT
On a clear day you can see Chapada Rubra from here. On a foggy day, you see fog.

Lá no alto do paredão fica o Mirante do.en: High up the cliff is the Pequi Tree Lookout. There's a pequi tree loaded with fruit and something shiny on the ground.

Só sobe quem tem o Amuleto de Escalar. D.en: Only those with the Climb Charm can go up. They say Prospector Topázio, from Chapada Rubra, gives one to whoever beats his gym.

A cidade tem nome de cobra, mas a cascav.en: The town is named after a snake, but our rattlesnakes are polite: they rattle before they arrive.

Meu avô diz que é para a gente respeitar.en: My grandpa says it's so we respect the Sertão. I do. From a distance.

Do buriti a gente aproveita tudo: a palh.en: We use every part of the buriti: the straw, the preserves, the oil and the shade.

O prédio de pedra lá em cima foi ginásio.en: The stone building up there was a gym in my day. The leader moved to the Coast, and the herbalist kept the hall. Better that way: now folks get healed in there instead of beaten.

Quer chegar em Pantanal Grande? Tem dois.en: Want to get to Pantanal Grande? There are two ways.

Por terra: sobe a Vereda, cruza o Cerrad.en: By land: up the Vereda, across Cerrado Aberto and down the Pantanal boardwalks. By water: canoe across the lagoon here and paddle east.

A Boiadeira Zefa é a líder de lá. Bicho.en: Cowgirl Zefa is the leader there. Earth critters that won't budge even with prayer. Bring River, Grass or Frost.

Eu conto os vagões todo dia. Hoje deu se.en: I count the train cars every day. Today there were seven.

Agora o trem traz Campeão da Liga! Você.en: Now the train brings League Champions! You're the third one I've seen. The other two went back to Porto Sereia crying.

Trabalho no Salão da Raizeira. A Dona Su.en: I work at the Herbalist's Hall. Dona Sucupira heals any creature for free and even teaches you the herb's name.

Atrás daquela rocha rachada, no canto oe.en: Behind that cracked rock, in the west corner, is her herb garden. The rock fell in the last rain. Anyone with Rock Smash can open it up.

O laboratório é a Estação de Pesquisa do.en: The lab is the Sertão Research Station. Dr. Buriti had it built before moving to Costa do Sol.

Estamos medindo as cheias do Pantanal. E.en: We're measuring the Pantanal floods. And the floods are measuring our patience.

Tá vendo aquela ilhota na lagoa? Meu cha.en: See that little island in the lagoon? My hat blew over there a year ago.

Quem tiver canoa pode ficar com o que ac.en: Anyone with a canoe can keep whatever they find. Just don't keep the hat, it was my father's.

Na lagoa só dá Piabinha de Vara Velha. P.en: In the lagoon there's only Piabinha on an Old Rod. The really big fish live in the Pantanal.

Rema para o leste e você chega no Pantan.en: Paddle east and you'll reach Pantanal Alagado. There a Good Rod catches Dourado-Rei, and the Master… the Master catches even fish stories.

Uma prateleira de iscas, anzóis e um cad.en: A shelf of bait, hooks and a notebook with the rookery egg count, year by year.

Um baú cheio de penas soltas de tuiuiú,.en: A chest full of loose tuiuiú feathers, sorted by color. "A fallen feather is a gift; a plucked feather is a crime," says the note.

A rede balança com o vento que entra pel.en: The hammock sways in the breeze coming through the cracks in the floor. Below, the lagoon water flows by slowly.

A vó cuida de um ninho de Tuiuiú no telh.en: Grandma looks after a Tuiuiú nest on the roof. The couple goes fishing and she keeps an eye on it.

Ela diz que tuiuiú volta para o mesmo ni.en: She says tuiuiús come back to the same nest every year. I come back to the same hammock every day.

Berrantes de chifre de todos os tamanhos.en: Cattle horns of every size. The smallest one plays a note so high only dogs and Ariranhão can hear it.

Um laço de couro trançado, uma sela velh.en: A braided leather lasso, an old saddle and a photo of a cattle drive crossing the flood with water up to the cattle's chests.

O oratório tem uma vela, um raminho de c.en: The little altar has a candle, a sprig of cambará and a horseshoe hung upside up, "to hold on to the luck".

O berrante chama a boiada de longe. Na c.en: The horn calls the herd from far away. In the flood season, it also calls the ranch hands who got lost.

A Zefa aprendeu a tocar comigo. Hoje toc.en: Zefa learned to play from me. Today she plays better. Don't tell her I said so.

O Cartel Ferrugem anda no ninhal, no sul.en: The Rust Cartel is prowling the rookery, down south. They take tuiuiú eggs to sell in golden cages in the big city.

Ovo de tuiuiú vale mais que boi. Bicho v.en: A tuiuiú egg is worth more than a cow. A living creature is worth more than anything, but they can't do that math.

Quadro de avisos: \"Soltura de jacarés n.en: Notice board: "Caiman release on Thursday. Please don't bring your lunch."

Fichas de resgate: espécie, peso, onde f.en: Rescue files: species, weight, where it was found and a drawing of the chick by the schoolkids.

Mamadeiras, conta-gotas e uma balança on.en: Baby bottles, droppers and a scale where a Tatuzim insists on sleeping.

Um mapa do ninhal com os ninhos marcados.en: A map of the rookery with the nests marked in green. The ones the Cartel raided are in red.

Um cesto forrado de capim, morninho. Alg.en: A basket lined with grass, still warm. Someone slept here and left fur behind.

Os filhotes tirados dos ninhos não sabem.en: The chicks taken from their nests don't know how to go back to the wild alone. They need someone to teach them.

Um treinador de Campeão ensina rápido. M.en: A Champion-level trainer teaches fast. But teach with love, okay? Chicks can tell.

(O Tatuzim residente se enrola feito bol.en: (The resident Tatuzim rolls up into a ball and rolls to the door. It does that with every visitor.)

GINÁSIO DE PANTANAL GRANDE\nLíder: Boiad.en:
PANTANAL GRANDE GYM
Leader: Cowgirl Zefa
"Feet in the mud, head in the sky."

Dica do curral: a lama afunda quando voc.en: Corral tip: the mud sinks once you step off it. The gate only opens after every bit of the pen has been stepped on.

Nem todo começo tem saída. Olhe bem a la.en: Not every start has a way out. Look at the mud carefully before you step: there's no going back.

Atolou? Os peões alisam a lama e devolve.en: Stuck? The ranch hands smooth the mud and bring you back to the edge of the pen. Each pen's bell does the same.

Bem-vindo ao curral da Zefa! Aqui o chão.en: Welcome to Zefa's corral! Here, the ground is the boss.

Pisou na lama e saiu, ela afunda. Para a.en: Step on the mud and off again, and it sinks. For the gate to open, the whole pen has to be stepped on, without repeating a single inch.

No primeiro cercado, comece por uma das.en: In the first pen, start at one of the ends or right in the middle. From the columns beside each of those, there's no way.

• Dona Brejeira, da primeira palafita, p.en: • Dona Brejeira, in the first stilt house, needs someone to watch a nest for a whole day.

• O Centro de Reabilitação procura quem.en: • The Rehab Center is looking for people to adopt rescued chicks (after the rookery is saved).

• AVISO DA BOIADEIRA: ninhal do sul inte.en: • NOTICE FROM THE COWGIRL: south rookery closed. Strangers messing with the eggs.

Dizem que a Zefa enfrenta desafiante mon.en: They say Zefa faces challengers riding an Emaçu. Not true: she walks, the Emaçu just follows.

Bicho de Terra não sente choque. Deixe o.en: Earth critters don't feel shocks. Leave your Thunder one in the Gourd Keep before entering the gym.

Vim de trem de Porto Sereia para ver o T.en: I came by train from Porto Sereia to see the Tuiuiú. I saw three! And a caiman saw me.

Me disseram que de noite, na água, os bi.en: They told me that at night, in the water, critters show up in pairs. I didn't stay to check.

Venda da Piúva: o que não tem aqui, a ca.en: Piúva's Shop: whatever's not here, the canoe brings on Thursday. Whatever the canoe doesn't bring, nobody needs.

Comprei vinte Cuias de Rede. Peguei um P.en: I bought twenty Net Gourds. I caught a Piranhão and it bit nineteen of them.

Pomada de Copaíba é boa para mordida. Co.en: Copaíba Ointment is good for bites. I bought twenty of those too.

GINÁSIO DE PANTANAL GRANDE\nLíder: Boiad.en:
PANTANAL GRANDE GYM
Leader: Cowgirl Zefa, the ranch hand.
"Mud's in no hurry, but it won't forgive whoever stops."

PANTANAL GRANDE\nCidade das palafitas. O.en:
PANTANAL GRANDE
Town of stilt houses. West: Pantanal Alagado and Vila Cascavel.

OLHO-D'ÁGUA\nA nascente fica no alto da.en:
OLHO-D'ÁGUA
The spring is at the top of the waterfall. You go up if the water lets you.

CENTRO DE REABILITAÇÃO DE FAUNA\nFilhote.en:
WILDLIFE REHAB CENTER
A rescued chick isn't merchandise: it's a responsibility.

A Boiadeira Zefa laça boi com uma mão e.en: Cowgirl Zefa lassoes cattle with one hand and holds her hat with the other!

No ginásio dela o chão é de lama. Se voc.en: In her gym the floor is mud. If you stop, you sink. If you run, you slip. I stayed in the stands.

Esse Antão do curral pensa que é boi. A.en: That Antão in the corral thinks it's a cow. We didn't have the heart to tell it.

Depois que você vencer a Zefa, ela vai p.en: After you beat Zefa, she'll ask for help with the rookery. There are Cartel folks messing with the eggs, south of the Pantanal.

Pirarucinho só morde Vara Velha, filhote.en: Pirarucinho only bites on an Old Rod, being a baby. The real Pirarucão, only with a Master Rod, and deep down.

A Vara Mestra? Ganhei de um pescador que.en: The Master Rod? I got it from a fisher who got it from another fisher. Nobody remembers where it started.

Daqui a canoa sai para o sul, mas o cana.en: From here canoes head south, but the rookery channel is blocked by Zefa's ranch hand.

E mais para baixo, perto de Porto Pantan.en: And further down, near Porto Pantaneiro, the Cartel stretched a net from bank to bank. Not even a minnow gets through.

Capim alto no pasto: Sapo-Cururuí de noi.en: Tall grass in the pasture: Sapo-Cururuí at night, Tuiuiú by day, Jacaretinga all the time.

E Pintada de vez em quando. Quando a Pin.en: And Pintada now and then. When the Pintada shows up, the whole pasture goes quiet.

Lá em cima da cascata tem uma nascente e.en: Up above the waterfall there's a spring and a stone that glows at night.

Meu avô diz que só sobe a água quem tem.en: My grandpa says only those with the Waterfall Charm can go up the water. I tried swimming. I came down faster than I went up.

(O Antão do curral muge. Não é um som de.en: (The Antão in the corral moos. That's not a tapir sound. It's convinced.)

Uma coleção de pedras com etiqueta: \"qu.en: A labeled rock collection: "rose quartz", "jasper", "pyrite (NOT GOLD)", "rock that looks like a Mocozim".

Uma bateia, uma peneira e um mapa de gar.en: A gold pan, a sieve and a prospecting map with an X drawn right on top of this house. Seu Cascalho is a suspicious man.

O velho troca tudo por pepita. Já trocou.en: The old man trades anything for nuggets. He's traded his watch, his hammock and almost traded the dog.

Pepita sai de rocha rachada, com o Quebr.en: Nuggets come out of cracked rocks, with Rock Smash. There are loads on the Estrada Vermelha and up here on the chapada.

Capacetes de mineiro enfileirados, um pa.en: Miners' helmets in a row, one for each kid. The smallest one has a little toy flashlight.

A carteira de trabalho da mina, guardada.en: The mine work card, carefully kept. Last entry: "Mine closed by order of strangers".

Trabalhei na Mina Velha a vida inteira..en: I worked in the Mina Velha my whole life. One day folks in rust-colored overalls showed up and said the mine was theirs now.

O Topázio ficou uma fera. Desceu sozinho.en: Topázio was furious. He went down alone. If you go down too, bring River or Grass creatures: the Cartel down there only has stone and poison critters.

Quando eu crescer vou ser garimpeira de.en: When I grow up I'm going to be a fossil hunter. Fossils don't run away.

O meu irmão diz que fóssil também não br.en: My brother says fossils don't play either. He doesn't get it.

GINÁSIO DE CHAPADA RUBRA\nLíder: Garimpe.en:
CHAPADA RUBRA GYM
Leader: Prospector Topázio
"Tough on the outside, shining on the inside."

Dica do garimpo: o vagonete segue o tril.en: Prospector's tip: the mine cart follows the track to the end. At the junctions, the switch lever is the boss.

Uma chave de desvio pode ficar bem longe.en: A switch lever can be far away from the junction it controls.

O desvio do trilho de cima fica na galer.en: The switch for the upper track is in the east gallery, on the other side of the chasm.

Uma gaiola do Cartel Ferrugem, vazia. No.en: A Rust Cartel cage, empty. On the floor, tuiuiú feathers and a tag: "ROOKERY LOT — FOREIGN SALE".

Um vagonete cheio de minério e, por baix.en: A mine cart full of ore and, under the ore, a box of eggs. Someone tried to hide stolen cargo.

Eu era vigia da mina. O Cartel me pôs pa.en: I was the mine's watchman. The Cartel threw me out and locked the lower gate.

A escada para a galeria funda fica no ca.en: The ladder to the deep gallery is in the northeast corner. The lieutenant is down there, with the cages and Topázio tied up.

Planilha do Cartel: \"Ovos de tuiuiú: 40.en: Cartel spreadsheet: "Tuiuiú eggs: 40. Macaw chicks: 12. Destination: foreign port. In charge: Lt. Rebite."

• Seu Cascalho, da casa amarela, troca p.en: • Seu Cascalho, in the yellow house, trades scrolls for nuggets. Go prospecting in the cracked rocks!

• URGENTE: a Mina Velha foi tomada pelo.en: • URGENT: the Mina Velha was taken over by the Rust Cartel. Prospector Topázio went down alone.

Os paredões ao norte só se sobem com o A.en: The cliffs to the north can only be climbed with the Climb Charm. Up top is the Chapada dos Paredões and, after that, Arraial Brasa.

Lá no alto tem também a boca da Caverna.en: Up high there's also the mouth of the Caverna Vulcânica. Dark as can be: Lantern required.

A Chapada Rubra é vermelha por causa do.en: Chapada Rubra is red because of the iron in the rock. Your boots will turn red too. Forever.

Bicho de Pedra apanha de Rio, Mata, Ging.en: Stone critters get beaten by River, Grass, Brawl, Earth and Iron. Topázio knows it and trains so you can't get close.

Venda do Garimpo! Aqui pepita vale troco.en: Prospector's Shop! Here nuggets count as change and change counts as nuggets. Kidding: it's patacas here.

Achei uma pedra dourada linda e paguei a.en: I found a lovely golden stone and paid my bill with it. Dona Hematita laughed so hard she gave me a discount.

Era pirita. Ouro de tolo. Mas o desconto.en: It was pyrite. Fool's gold. But the discount was real.

GINÁSIO DA CHAPADA RUBRA\nLíder: Garimpe.en:
CHAPADA RUBRA GYM
Leader: Prospector Topázio.
"Rough stone shines too. It just needs someone to cut it."

MINA VELHA DA CHAPADA\nDesativada desde.en:
CHAPADA OLD MINE
Shut down since the great flood. No entry.
(Someone crossed out "No entry" and wrote "Cartel only".)

CHAPADA RUBRA\nOeste: Estrada Vermelha..en:
CHAPADA RUBRA
West: Estrada Vermelha. North, up the cliff: Chapada dos Paredões and Arraial Brasa.

LAJE DO GARIMPEIRO\nQuem subir a laje co.en:
PROSPECTOR'S LEDGE
Whoever climbs the ledge by the creepers finds what the prospector forgot.

A porta do ginásio está trancada com um.en:
The gym door is locked with an ore padlock. A note stuck to it says:
"Went to the Mina Velha to run the Cartel off. Back when the mine belongs to the people again. — Topázio"

O mestre Topázio desceu na Mina Velha fa.en: Master Topázio went down into the Mina Velha three days ago. He said he was going to "have a chat" with the Cartel.

A boca da mina fica a leste, depois da f.en: The mine entrance is to the east, past the bonfire. If you go, bring a Lantern… no, the mine has lights. Bring courage.

O mestre voltou e abriu o ginásio! Ele d.en: The master came back and opened the gym! He said you saved the mine. And him. But mostly the mine.

Lá dentro os trilhos dos vagonetes mudam.en: Inside, the mine cart tracks change with the switch levers. Think before you hop in.

Meu pai achou uma pedra que muda de cor.en: My dad found a stone that changes color in the sun. He calls it a "mood stone".

Hoje está cinza. Ele também..en: Today it's gray. So is he.

Aquele poço cercado é lava de verdade. A.en: That fenced pit is real lava. The chapada sits on top of a sleeping volcano.

Mais ao norte, depois dos paredões, tem.en: Further north, past the cliffs, is the Caverna Vulcânica. The ancients say a fire serpent sleeps there. I say my fear sleeps there.

Paredão com trepadeira: quem tem o Amule.en: A cliff with creepers: anyone with the Climb Charm and a Brawl, Normal or Bug creature climbs right up.

É o Topázio que entrega o Amuleto. Por i.en: Topázio is the one who hands out the Charm. That's why everyone here is rooting for someone to save the mine.

Desci a Estrada Vermelha com tropa de mu.en: I came down the Estrada Vermelha with a mule train. Halfway, an Escorpião-Rei sat on my hat.

Deixei o chapéu com ele. Tem coisa que n.en: I left the hat with it. Some things you don't argue about.

Trabalhei vinte anos naquela mina. Agora.en: I worked twenty years in that mine. Now the Cartel uses the tunnels to hide stolen critters.

Ouvi barulho de gaiola e de Tatucanastra.en: I heard cages rattling and a Tatucanastra scratching. Tatucanastras don't like cages. Nobody does.

Chapéus de palha com remendo de chita, b.en: Straw hats patched with calico, folded bunting and a square dance caller's notebook: "Look, rain! Just kidding!"

Vestidos de festa junina e um bigode pos.en: Festa junina dresses and a fake mustache kept in a jar, like a relic.

A máquina de costura está no meio de um.en: The sewing machine is halfway through a plaid dress. The pedal is still warm.

Costuro os vestidos da quadrilha desde m.en: I've sewn the square dance dresses since I was a girl. This year, Smith Labareda asked for one with embroidered sparks.

Faísca bordada pega fogo? Pega. Já estou.en: Do embroidered sparks catch fire? They do. I'm on my third dress.

Fui marcador de quadrilha quarenta anos..en: I was a square dance caller for forty years. "Balancê! Down the country road!"

Hoje só marco a hora do café. \"Anarriê.en: Now I only call coffee time. "Anarriê to the kitchen!"

Um sino de bronze desenhado a carvão na.en: A bronze bell drawn in charcoal on the wall, with the measurements noted: "for the Vila Cascavel chapel".

A fornalha da forja, com brasa viva. O c.en: The forge furnace, with live embers. The heat touches your face like an auntie's hug.

Ferraduras, facões, sinos pequenos e uma.en: Horseshoes, machetes, little bells and a toy anvil the smith made for his grandson.

Tenazes, martelos e uma lima. Tudo com o.en: Tongs, hammers and a file. All with handles worn into the shape of Malho's hand.

O vô diz que o Boitatá da caverna é pare.en: Grandpa says the Boitatá in the cave is related to the forge fire.

Eu acho que é parente do vô: os dois sol.en: I think it's related to Grandpa: they both blow smoke when they get mad.

GINÁSIO DE ARRAIAL BRASA\nLíder: Ferreir.en:
ARRAIAL BRASA GYM
Leader: Smith Labareda
"Iron bends in the fire; people, at the party."

Dica do arraial: cada fogueira acende nu.en: Arraial tip: each bonfire lights up on a note. Light them in the order of the accordionist's song and the embers on the path cool down.

Errou a nota? As fogueiras do terreiro a.en: Wrong note? The yard's bonfires go out and the song starts over from the top.

Cada terreiro tem o seu sanfoneiro. Fale.en: Each yard has its own accordionist. Talk to them as often as you like: the song doesn't change.

Pregada na parede, uma folha de cordel:\.en:
Nailed to the wall, a cordel leaflet:
"In the third yard nobody blinks, my friend: to get through, listen for the song's name till the end."

• Festa de São João no terreiro, todo sá.en: • São João party in the yard, every Saturday! Dona Quentão is looking for help lighting the bonfires.

• Ferreiro Malho, da forja grande: afia.en: • Smith Malho, at the great forge: sharpens moves, fixes pots and tells tall tales.

Sou sobrinho da Engenheira Bigorna, da V.en: I'm Engineer Bigorna's nephew, from Vila Ferrugem. Everyone in the family hammers iron. I hammer hot iron.

A Ferreira Labareda usa Brasa, mas guard.en: Smith Labareda uses Ember, but keeps a Stone critter in the middle. Don't go in with only River creatures: bring an Earth one too.

Vim para a festa de São João e fiquei pe.en: I came for the São João party and stayed by the bonfire. That was three years ago.

No sábado o quentão é de graça. No domin.en: On Saturday the mulled drink is free. On Sunday, so is the headache.

Venda da Festa! Cuia, remédio e doce de.en: Party Shop! Gourds, medicine and peanut candy. The candy doesn't heal, but nobody complains.

Comprei Rapadura para o meu Calangão sub.en: I bought Rapadura so my Calangão would level up. It went up one level and jumped off the table with the whole rapadura.

Mesmo assim valeu. Rapadura é rapadura..en: Still worth it. Rapadura is rapadura.

GINÁSIO DE ARRAIAL BRASA\nLíder: Ferreir.en:
ARRAIAL BRASA GYM
Leader: Smith Labareda.
"Iron only learns in the fire. So do people."

ARRAIAL BRASA\nSul: Chapada dos Paredões.en:
ARRAIAL BRASA
South: Chapada dos Paredões. East: Trilha da Roda, to Cidade Ginga.
Bonfire yard: São João party every Saturday.

TRILHA DA RODA → CIDADE GINGA\nPorteira.en:
TRILHA DA RODA → CIDADE GINGA
Capoeiristas' gate: only those with the Flame Badge get through.

Lagoa da Cascata Velha. A prateleira lá.en: Old Waterfall Lagoon. The ledge up top belongs to whoever climbs the water.

Um capoeirista abre os braços na porteir.en:
A capoeirista spreads his arms at the Trilha da Roda gate:
"Hey, comrade! The trail's roda is for those who've been through Labareda's fire." "Come back with the Flame Badge and the berimbau will play you through."

Toda noite de sábado tem quadrilha no te.en: Every Saturday night there's a square dance in the yard. The bonfire lights itself when the accordion strikes up the baião.

Sozinha não: é a Ferreira Labareda que a.en: Not by itself: Smith Labareda lights it with her Calangão. But we pretend it's a miracle.

Carvão daqui vai para as forjas e as for.en: Charcoal from here goes to the forges, and the forges make horseshoes, knives and bells.

O Cartel queria comprar todo o ferro da.en: The Cartel wanted to buy all the town's iron to make cages. Labareda ran them off with a hammer in each hand.

Insígnia da Chama no peito! Pode passar,.en: Flame Badge on your chest! Go on through, comrade. The Trilha da Roda leads to Cidade Ginga.

Lá o Mestre Gingado espera. Treine a gin.en: Master Gingado waits there. Practice your ginga: in his gym, the berimbau is the boss.

A Ferreira Labareda acende as fogueiras.en: Smith Labareda lights the gym's bonfires in the order of a song. Miss a note and everything goes out.

Bicho de Brasa sofre com Rio, Terra e Pe.en: Ember critters suffer against River, Earth and Stone. But Labareda keeps a Stone Calangão in the middle to trick you.

Eu recorto bandeirinha de papel para a f.en: I cut out paper bunting for the party. I've made five hundred!

O vento levou trezentas. Sobrou duzentas.en: The wind took three hundred. I've got two hundred left and a cold.

A Caverna Vulcânica fica no terceiro deg.en: The Caverna Vulcânica is on the third step of the Chapada dos Paredões, going down from here.

O Boitatá de lá só aparece para quem tem.en: The Boitatá in there only shows up for those with the Crystal Badge. And it only stays with those with patience and a Gold Gourd.

♪ …e atenção, ouvintes da Rádio Cipó: ca.en: ♪ …and attention, Rádio Cipó listeners: a strange load of cages spotted on the Brejo Roxo road… ♪

No meu tempo a roda ia até o sol nascer..en: In my day the roda went on till sunrise.

Hoje eu durmo às oito. Mas sonho que est.en: Nowadays I'm asleep by eight. But I dream I'm sweeping legs.

O Mestre Gingado tem uma Quero-Guarda qu.en: Master Gingado has a Quero-Guarda that flies AND kicks!

Tipo Vento e tipo Ginga ao mesmo tempo..en: Wind type and Brawl type at the same time. Hit it with a Frost move!

A máquina de costura ainda está com um a.en: The sewing machine still has a huge abadá stuck under the foot: eight meters of white pants.

Moldes de abadá em todos os tamanhos, de.en: Abadá patterns in every size, from Saguinho to Capivarona.

Costuro abadá para gente e para criatura.en: I sew abadás for people and for creatures.

O mais difícil foi o da Sucurião do Dout.en: The hardest was the one for Doctor Peçonha's Sucurião, out in Brejo Roxo. Eight meters of pants.

Ele sumiu faz dias e não veio buscar a e.en: He disappeared days ago and never came to pick up his order. Strange: that man never misses a deadline, not even to take poison.

O Doutor Peçonha veio buscar o abadá da.en: Doctor Peçonha came for the Sucurião's abadá! He said he'd been stuck in a Cartel cage.

Pagou com uma cobra de pelúcia. Eu aceit.en: He paid with a stuffed snake. I took it. Stuffed snakes don't bite.

Pedi a calça branca e ela veio com um bo.en: I ordered white pants and they came with a Gourd pocket. Genius!

Um retrato do Mestre Cabaça moço, de cab.en: A portrait of young Master Cabaça, with an afro and bell-bottoms, mid rabo-de-arraia kick.

Um berimbau de biriba com a cabaça remen.en: A biriba-wood berimbau with a patched gourd. It smells like old parties.

Troféus de roda, fitas de batizado e um.en: Roda trophies, batizado ribbons and a songbook in the Master's shaky handwriting.

Eu sou a única que não fugiu do treino..en: I'm the only one who didn't skip practice.

Não por virtude: é que eu durmo aqui na.en: Not out of virtue: I sleep here in the hammock.

Anzóis, chumbadas e um bilhete: \"Jaú-Gi.en: Hooks, sinkers and a note: "Jaú-Gigante: only in the Tunnel's cave, and only with a serious rod."

Fruto fresco, colhido hoje! Plante nos c.en: Fresh fruit, picked today! Plant it in the beds and come back later.

Se a criatura segurar o fruto, ela come.en: If a creature holds a fruit, it eats it by itself in a pinch. More polite than a lot of people.

Pergaminhos de Técnica: golpe de livro,.en: Technique Scrolls: moves from a book, but they hurt just the same.

Pedra Solar, Maré, Lunar… Vieram da Chap.en: Sun Stone, Tide Stone, Moon Stone… They came from Chapada Rubra on muleback.

Eu provo de tudo antes de comprar..en: I taste everything before I buy.

Hoje já provei cocada, pé de moleque, qu.en: Today I've already tasted cocada, peanut brittle, grilled cheese and the patience of the whole fair.

Moço, moça, me empresta dez patacas?.en: Hey, you, could you lend me ten patacas?

É para comprar uma Cuia de Mel. A minha.en: It's to buy a Honey Gourd. My Jataí deserves it.

GINÁSIO DE CIDADE GINGA\nLíder: Mestre G.en:
CIDADE GINGA GYM
Leader: Master Gingado
"If you can't handle the mandinga, don't wear the charm."

Dica da roda: o camarada chama os golpes.en: Roda tip: your partner calls the moves, one arrow per berimbau beat. Then it's your turn: send back the same arrows, each on its beat.

Não adianta correr na frente do berimbau.en: No use rushing ahead of the berimbau. Press the arrow when the beat sounds, not before, not after.

Numa volta, a roda perdoa um tropeço. Do.en: In one round, the roda forgives one stumble. Two, and the game starts over.

Um berimbau de verga de biriba e cabaça.en: A berimbau with a biriba bow and a painted gourd. The Angola rhythm is slow: there's time to think.

Um berimbau médio. O toque de Benguela é.en: A medium berimbau. The Benguela rhythm is in between: not slow, not quick.

O berimbau gunga, de som grosso. No São.en: The gunga berimbau, deep-sounding. In São Bento Grande the roda catches fire: the rhythm is fast and the game is long.

• O Mestre Cabaça procura três alunos qu.en: • Master Cabaça is looking for three students who skipped practice for the Trilha da Roda.

• Dona Dendê, da Feira, precisa de pequi.en: • Dona Dendê, at the Fair, needs pequi, cashew and açaí for her stall.

• Sábado é dia de Roda Grande na praça:.en: • Saturday is Big Roda day in the square: Contramestra Maré takes challenges from those who've beaten her.

• Quinta é dia de feira: a Artesã Cabaci.en: • Thursday is fair day: Artisan Cabacinha brings custom gourds.

Minha Prego-Mestre torceu o rabo num aú.en: My Prego-Mestre twisted its tail on a sloppy cartwheel.

A máquina do Posto resolve em três acord.en: The Post machine fixes it in three chords. It's basically a berimbau with blinking lights.

Depois da insígnia do Mestre Gingado, a.en: After Master Gingado's badge, you get the Waterfall Charm.

Aí dá para subir a cascata do Túnel Alag.en: Then you can climb the Túnel Alagado waterfall up to Brejo Roxo… and go back to the Costa do Sol to climb the Rio Cachoeira-Véu. The world goes around, and we go with it.

Você mergulha desde a insígnia da Boiade.en: You've been diving since Cowgirl Zefa's badge, right? Then the Túnel Alagado won't scare you.

O que assusta é a gruta do meio: ar para.en: What's scary is the cave in the middle: still air, echoes and a hermit who talks to himself.

Bem-vindo! Aqui o troco vem com um passo.en: Welcome! Here your change comes with a free ginga step.

Cuia de Rede é uma mão na roda para bich.en: Net Gourds are a big help with water critters.

No Túnel Alagado você vai agradecer. Ou.en: In the Túnel Alagado you'll thank me. Or you won't, because you'll be underwater. Thank me now.

CIDADE GINGA\n\"Quem não ginga, tropeça..en:
CIDADE GINGA
"Whoever doesn't sway, stumbles."
West: Trilha da Roda, to Arraial Brasa.

GINÁSIO DE CIDADE GINGA\nLíder: Mestre G.en:
CIDADE GINGA GYM
Leader: Master Gingado, the singing foot.
Berimbau Badge.

LAGOA DO BERIMBAU\nO poço fundo no meio.en:
BERIMBAU LAGOON
The deep pool in the middle is the mouth of the Túnel Alagado, which comes out in Brejo Roxo.
No diving without a Charm. (The lifeguard is a capybara and she's off today.)

FEIRA DA CIDADE GINGA\nFrutos, cuias de.en:
CIDADE GINGA FAIR
Fruit, artisan gourds and scrolls.
Thursdays: Artisan Cabacinha's stall with custom gourds.

MIRANTE DA CASCATA\n\"Daqui de cima a ci.en:
WATERFALL LOOKOUT
"From up here the whole town looks like a roda." — carved in the stone by one of Master Cabaça's students

Estátua de bronze de um capoeirista no m.en: A bronze statue of a capoeirista mid-cartwheel. On the base: "Master Gingado, Big Roda champion".

Na roda só entra quem bate palma no temp.en: Only those who clap on the beat get into the roda. You clap like you're swatting mosquitoes, but that's okay.

Aqui a gente treina com as criaturas, nã.en: Here we train with the creatures, not against them.

Criatura do tipo Ginga derruba Comum, Pe.en: Brawl creatures knock down Normal, Stone, Iron and Frost. But if a little bird shows up… we lose our groove.

O ginásio é uma academia: cada duelo aco.en: The gym is an academy: every duel happens to the berimbau's rhythm.

Tipo Vento, Mente e Encanto fazem o povo.en: Wind, Mind and Charm types make the Master's crew lose their footing.

Eu? Eu só guardo os chinelos da turma..en: Me? I just watch everybody's flip-flops.

Tá vendo a água escura lá no meio? É fun.en: See the dark water in the middle? It goes down forever.

O túnel por baixo sai lá no Brejo Roxo..en: The tunnel underneath comes out in Brejo Roxo. My grandpa used to cross it holding his breath. My grandpa told a lot of fibs.

No meio do túnel tem uma gruta com ar e.en: In the middle of the tunnel there's a cave with air and a waterfall that goes up. Without the Waterfall Charm, the cave is the end of the line.

Eu sei dar estrela, ponte e bananeira!.en: I can do cartwheels, backbends and handstands!

A minha Quatizão só sabe dar trabalho..en: My Quatizão only knows how to do trouble.

Menino, passou por aqui um povo de macac.en: Dear, some folks in rust-colored overalls came by buying sacks and sacks of lime.

Disseram que iam \"limpar\" o Brejo Roxo.en: They said they were going to "clean up" Brejo Roxo. Since when do you clean a swamp?

Eu não sou de falar da vida alheia. Mas.en: I'm not one to gossip. But it sure is fishy.

Soube? Derrubaram o esconderijo do Carte.en: Heard? They brought down the Cartel hideout in Brejo Roxo! Some Queixada ran out of there and brush sprouted wherever it went.

Eu não sou de espalhar notícia. Mas já c.en: I'm not one to spread news. But I've already told the whole town.

Olha a garrafada! Levanta até defunto de.en: Herbal tonic here! It'll raise a creature from the dead!

Levanta nada. Mas cura que é uma beleza..en: It won't. But it heals like a charm.

Biscoito de polvilho, rapadura e fumaça.en: Tapioca biscuits, rapadura and andiroba smoke!

A rapadura é dura. O preço também..en: The rapadura is hard. So is the price.

Vim de Porto Sereia só para a feira..en: I came from Porto Sereia just for the fair.

Já comprei um berimbau, dois caxixis e u.en: I've already bought a berimbau, two caxixis and a backache from trying a cartwheel.

Eu treino apneia aqui. Meu recorde é doi.en: I practice breath-holding here. My record is two minutes.

A minha Poraquê aguenta vinte. E ainda a.en: My Poraquê can last twenty. And it lights things up down there.

No Túnel Alagado, suba nas clareiras de.en: In the Túnel Alagado, surface at the patches of light: that's how you get back up.

Tá olhando o quê? Estou só… contando man.en: What are you looking at? I'm just… counting mangoes.

Circulando, circulando. Este quintal é p.en: Move along, move along. This yard is private. The Cartel's. I mean, nobody's.

A casa de azulejo é a Academia do Mestre.en: The tiled house is Master Cabaça's Academy, the oldest master in town.

Ele anda procurando três alunos fujões..en: He's been looking for three runaway students. If you want to help, go in.

O Posto Guardião cura de graça e guarda.en: The Guardian Post heals for free and keeps your gourds in the Gourd Keep.

Dica da casa: o Mestre Gingado luta com.en: House tip: Master Gingado fights with Brawl creatures. Wind, Mind and Charm hit them hard.

\"Como Conversar com Cobras\", \"Cobras:.en: "How to Talk to Snakes", "Snakes: They Don't Want to Talk" and a frog sticker album.

No Vale do Veneno a água é grossa de tão.en: In the Vale do Veneno the water is thick it's so purple, but the canoe gets through.

Tem Sucurião lá que pesca a gente em vez.en: There's a Sucurião out there that fishes for you instead of you fishing for it. Paddle fast.

Meu nome é Piabinha igual ao peixe. Meu.en: My name is Piabinha, like the fish. My brother's name is Mandi. My dad really likes fishing.

Vidros de raiz, casca e flor. Um deles e.en: Jars of roots, bark and flowers. One is labeled "NOT TEA". Another, "MAYBE TEA".

Dizem que no fundo do Vale do Veneno mor.en: They say deep in the Vale do Veneno lives a Coralzinha with glowing rings. Rare as can be.

E que as árvores de lá escondem Marimbon.en: And that the trees there hide Marimbondão. Shake and run. In that order.

Quando o brejo sarar, as criaturas volta.en: When the swamp heals, the creatures come back. A swamp is stubborn, just like us.

GINÁSIO DE BREJO ROXO\nLíder: Doutor Peç.en:
BREJO ROXO GYM
Leader: Doctor Peçonha
"Poison and medicine: the difference is the dose."

Aviso do serpentário: no piso tóxico voc.en: Serpentarium notice: on toxic floor you can last 3 steps. The antidote plant restores all your breath… and wilts right away. Clean floor doesn't cost or restore.

Sair do tanque faz as plantas rebrotarem.en: Leaving the tank makes the plants grow back. Fainted? The assistants bring you back to the tank entrance.

Conselho do Doutor: antes de pisar, cont.en: The Doctor's advice: count before you step. Every plant you skip now might be missing later on.

Uma jaula vazia. Na plaqueta: \"Lote 12.en: An empty cage. On the tag: "Lot 12 — cururu toads — SENT TO LEVEL 2".

PRESSÃO DAS CALDEIRAS DE PEÇONHA: ALTA.\.en:
VENOM BOILER PRESSURE: HIGH.
Someone stuck a note on it: "don't touch, that's Doctor Zinabre's job".

REGISTRO DE CARGA\n• 212 anfíbios do Bre.en:
CARGO LOG
• 212 Brejo Roxo amphibians
• 38 Vale serpents
• 1 "special specimen" (reinforced cage, level 3)
• 1 nosy herpetologist (cell, level 2)

Uma porta blindada com o emblema da engr.en:
An armored door with the rusty gear emblem.
A thick cable comes out of it and runs along the wall to the east, to the machine room.

Eu só fui contratado para passar pano. N.en: I was only hired to mop. Nobody told me the mop would melt.

A porta lá de cima? Abre na alavanca da.en: The door upstairs? It opens with the lever in the machine room, to the east. I didn't say anything.

ESTEIRAS: LIGADAS.\nDESTINO DAS JAULAS:.en:
CONVEYORS: ON.
CAGE DESTINATION: "BUYERS — COSTA DO SOL".

Frascos de peçonha rotulados por espécie.en: Venom flasks labeled by species. There's a price list. It makes you want to smash everything.

Sapos-cururu espremidos, olhando para vo.en: Cururu toads squeezed together, staring at you.

Uma Jararaquinha enrolada num canto, tre.en: A Jararaquinha curled up in a corner, trembling.

Pererequinhas. Uma delas acena. Ou é imp.en: Pererequinhas. One of them waves. Or so it seems.

A tranca desta cela é diferente: tem um.en: This cell's lock is different: it has a keypad. And someone inside whistling to a snake.

PROJETO CAIPORA\n\"O espécime resiste à.en:
PROJECT CAIPORA
"The specimen resists sedation. Wherever it steps, brush sprouts from the concrete. The Colonel wants its secret by the full moon."

Comporta do núcleo. Duas luzes vermelhas.en:
Core floodgate. Two red lights blink: "LEVER A — CAGES" and "LEVER B — DISTILLERY".
Until both turn green, no dice.

NÍVEL 3 — NÚCLEO\nAcesso restrito à Dout.en:
LEVEL 3 — CORE
Access restricted to Doctor Zinabre and Lieutenant Lata.
"Whoever lets cage 176 open cleans the swamp with a toothbrush. — Col. Garrote"

Seringas de sedativo vazias, uma atrás d.en: Empty sedative syringes, one after another. Next to them, an ipê sprout growing out of one.

A criatura bufa atrás das grades. O conc.en: The creature snorts behind the bars. The concrete around it is cracked, full of green sprouts.

• PROCURA-SE: Doutor Peçonha, líder do g.en: • MISSING: Doctor Peçonha, gym leader. Last seen heading to the Abandoned Tannery with a lantern and a snake around his neck.

• Dona Rã, do charco, procura as cinco P.en: • Dona Rã, from the marsh, is looking for the five Pererequinhas she raised loose in her yard. Two hopped off to the Vale do Veneno.

• O Carteiro Sapé precisa de alguém que.en: • Mail Carrier Sapé needs someone to go up the mountain with a letter for Serra da Geada.

Fui lavar o rosto no riacho roxo. Agora.en: I washed my face in the purple creek. Now I'm like this, green.

A atendente disse que passa. Disse rindo.en: The attendant said it'll go away. She was laughing, but she said it.

O Cartel Ferrugem rouba criatura para ve.en: The Rust Cartel steals creatures to sell and, by the looks of it, to study venom.

Capanga deles adora criatura de Veneno e.en: Their goons love Poison and Iron creatures. Bring Earth types, they hit both.

Jararacuçu, Coralzinha, Sucurião… o Vale.en: Jararacuçu, Coralzinha, Sucurião… the Vale do Veneno is the best place in the world to study snakes.

E o pior para tropeçar. Use a Fumaça de.en: And the worst place to trip. Use Andiroba Smoke if you don't want company.

Botica do Brejo! Antídoto para tudo, men.en: Swamp Apothecary! An antidote for everything, except the prices.

Estou decorando: Mel Puro para veneno, U.en: I'm memorizing: Pure Honey for poison, Ointment for burns, Copaíba Ointment for everything.

E Chá de Guaraná para quem desmaiou. Ser.en: And Guaraná Tea for the fainted. Works for creatures and for Mondays.

PASSO DA SERRA\nNorte: Subida da Serra e.en:
SERRA PASS
North: Subida da Serra and Serra da Geada.
Only those with the Thorn Badge go up. And a coat.

GINÁSIO DE BREJO ROXO\nLíder: Doutor Peç.en:
BREJO ROXO GYM
Leader: Doctor Peçonha, the man who hugs snakes.
Thorn Badge.

VALE DO VENENO →\nNão beba a água. Não l.en:
VALE DO VENENO →
Don't drink the water. Don't lick the frogs. Don't say we didn't warn you.

CHARCO DO TÚNEL\nFundo de lama, saída pa.en:
TUNNEL MARSH
Muddy bottom, exit to Cidade Ginga underwater.

CURTUME ABANDONADO\nFechado desde a últi.en:
ABANDONED TANNERY
Closed since the last flood.
(Someone scribbled underneath: "then why is purple smoke coming out of the chimney?")

BREJO ROXO\n\"Aqui até o sapo tem nome e.en:
BREJO ROXO
"Here even the frogs have a first and last name."

Um totem de madeira com uma cobra entalh.en: A wooden totem with a carved snake biting its own tail. On the base: "poison and cure live in the same fang".

Guarda-serra Pinheiro: \"Daqui para cima.en:
Mountain Ranger Pinheiro: "From here up it's cliffs, boulders and bone-cracking cold.
Without Doctor Peçonha's Thorn Badge I'm not letting you up. Guardians' orders."

Zelador Urtigão: \"O ginásio está fechad.en:
Caretaker Urtigão: "The gym is closed. Doctor Peçonha went to look into the tannery's purple smoke and never came back.
It's been three days. The snakes miss him. So do I, but don't tell him."

As flores roxas do brejo estão murchando.en: The swamp's purple flowers are wilting. Lime and chemicals are leaking out of the tannery.

Os sapos sumiram, as pererecas sumiram….en: The frogs are gone, the tree frogs are gone… and every night a cart goes by with cages under a tarp.

Se você tem criatura que corta cipó, dê.en: If you have a creature that cuts vines, take a look behind the fence. I'll stay here… watching the flowers.

Os sapos voltaram para o brejo na mesma.en: The frogs came back to the swamp the same night you took down the lab. They sang till morning.

Brejo saudável é brejo barulhento. Ningu.en: A healthy swamp is a noisy swamp. Nobody slept, and everybody woke up happy.

Você saiu de dentro do charco?! Achei qu.en: You came out of the marsh?! I thought you were a ghost.

O túnel vai dar em Cidade Ginga. Mande u.en: The tunnel comes out in Cidade Ginga. Say hi to my cousin Tainha. Tell him he owes me twenty patacas.

Menino, aqui todo mundo tem um chazinho.en: Dear, everyone here has a little tea for poison.

Mel Puro tira peçonha de bicho. Para peç.en: Pure Honey draws the venom out of critters. For people's venom, you have to move to another town.

Eu sei pular todas as poças de lama sem.en: I can jump over every mud puddle without getting my feet dirty!

…Menos esta. E aquela. E a outra..en: …Except this one. And that one. And the other one.

O Doutor diz que veneno é só remédio na.en: The Doctor says poison is just medicine at the wrong dose.

Tipo Terra e tipo Mente dão dor de cabeç.en: Earth and Mind types give his snakes a headache. Grass types, poor things, turn into salad.

A fumaça parou! O brejo voltou a cheirar.en: The smoke stopped! The swamp smells like… swamp again.

Dizem que uma queixada enorme saiu corre.en: They say a huge peccary came running out of the tannery, with leaves sprouting wherever it stepped.

Me pagaram para levar caixas até o curtu.en: They paid me to haul boxes to the tannery. One of them snored.

Caixa não ronca, criatura. Larguei tudo.en: Boxes don't snore, friend. I dropped everything and came for some tea.

Insígnia Espinho! Pode subir. A Subida d.en: Thorn Badge! You can go up. The Subida da Serra has creeper cliffs and boulders in the way.

Lá no alto, à esquerda, tem a trilha do.en: Up top, to the left, is the Pico Pingorama trail. The guide there only takes those with all sixteen badges to the Peak: that's where the Guardians are.

SALÃO DO CONSELHO DOS GUARDIÕES\n1. Entr.en:
COUNCIL OF GUARDIANS HALL
1. Once in, no going back.  2. Five battles in a row.  3. Healing from your bag only.
4. Lose, and back down to the Gate.  5. Win, and up to Memory.

Uma estátua de Guardião com os olhos fec.en: A statue of a Guardian with closed eyes. On the base, the name of whoever beat the Council a hundred years ago.

O Marco da Memória: um tronco de pau-bra.en: The Memory Marker: a brazilwood trunk carved with the names of everyone who has climbed up here. There's room for one more.

A porta da sala de espera fechou atrás d.en: The waiting room door closed behind you. In the Council you only move forward.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Sea Guardian.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Forest Guardian.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Sky Guardian.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Earth Guardian. On the other side waits the High Guardian.

A porta da Sala da Memória só se abre pe.en: The Memory Room door only opens by the High Guardian's hand.

• O Conselho dos Guardiões recebe desafi.en: • The Council of Guardians welcomes challengers with sixteen badges. Five battles in a row, no Post in between.

• Aviso dos Guardiões: homens do Cartel.en: • Guardians' notice: Rust Cartel men were seen heading up to the Summit with chains. Be careful.

• Quem perder no Salão é trazido de volt.en: • Anyone who loses in the Hall is brought back to the Gate. Healing here is free.

Tentei o Conselho três vezes. Cheguei à.en: I've tried the Council three times. Reached Jandaia once. Her sky is full of lightning.

Dica de quem caiu muito: compre Elixir e.en: Advice from someone who fell a lot: buy Elixir and Guaraná Tea. In there, every heal is worth a battle.

Meu avô subia esta trilha para levar rec.en: My grandpa used to climb this trail to carry messages from one map to the other. On foot! Nowadays you all come by train and by saveiro.

O Guardião-Mor Arandu é mais velho que e.en: High Guardian Arandu is older than this mountain, they say. Not true. But almost.

Última venda antes do Conselho! Preço de.en: Last shop before the Council! High-altitude prices, but it's what there is: good medicine, good gourds and free pine nuts.

Subi para vender casaco e esqueci o meu..en: I came up here to sell coats and forgot my own. I've been in a T-shirt since Tuesday.

Os Guardiões não usam casaco. Dizem que.en: The Guardians don't wear coats. They say battle keeps you warm.

PICO PINGORAMA — ACAMPAMENTO DA FRONTEIR.en:
PICO PINGORAMA — FRONTIER CAMP
South: Monte Tupã (Costa do Sol). Post and Shop at the camp.

PICO PINGORAMA — FRONTIER CAMP
South: Subida da Serra (Sertão das Névoas). Post and Shop at the camp.

PORTÃO DOS GUARDIÕES\n\"Dezesseis insígn.en:
GUARDIANS' GATE
"Sixteen badges open the gate. A whole team opens the Council."

O CUME\nAdiante, o Salão do Conselho dos.en:
THE SUMMIT
Ahead, the Council of Guardians Hall. Inside: five battles, no way back.

MIRANTE DO CUME\nA oeste, a Costa do Sol.en:
SUMMIT LOOKOUT
To the west, all of Costa do Sol down to the sea. To the east, the Sertão as far as the mist allows.

Um Guardião antigo, de pedra, com o caja.en: An ancient stone Guardian, staff pointed at the summit. On the base: "Who climbs, climbs for all."

A trilha do Monte Tupã desce para a Cost.en:
The Monte Tupã trail goes down to Costa do Sol. Guardian Abaeté, down below, only lets through those who already have fifteen badges.
Without all sixteen, the Peak takes no one to the other side.

A porta de pedra do Salão do Conselho nã.en:
The stone door of the Council Hall won't budge.
Someone from the Cartel chained the bronze rings.

O guardião Tibiriçá, de cocar de penas d.en:
Guardian Tibiriçá, in a headdress of hawk feathers, raises an open hand:
— This is the Guardians' Gate. From here up, only those who beat the sixteen gyms of Pingorama. — There's no shame in turning back. The mountains will wait. When your case is full, the gate opens by itself.

Esta trilha liga a Costa do Sol ao Sertã.en: This trail has linked Costa do Sol to the Sertão since before there were roads. Drovers went up with mules and came down with stories.

Lá no Cume fica o Salão do Conselho. Cin.en: Up on the Summit is the Council Hall. Five Guardians, one after another. Nobody I know got past the second.

Pinhão cozido na fogueira, quentão sem á.en: Pine nuts roasted on the fire, alcohol-free mulled cider and guaraná tea. That's the camp menu.

Os capangas do Cartel subiram ontem com.en: The Cartel goons came up yesterday with crates and chains. Didn't pay for their pine nuts. That I don't forgive.

No Pico o ar é fino. Respire fundo antes.en: On the Peak the air is thin. Breathe deep before each battle and bring medicine in your bag: up there nobody heals you for free.

O Posto daqui é o último antes do Consel.en: This Post is the last one before the Council. If you lose in there, the Guardians bring you to the Gate — and the Post is just below.

Prateleiras cheias: cuias, chás, rapadur.en: Full shelves: gourds, teas, brown sugar and a jar of pickled pequi nobody has the nerve to open.
